  test("staffAlert writes the row of each kind of 3c and 3e, with its counts and times, and marks it mailed whether or not an address took the mail; the tick never mails it again", async () => {
    const at = new Date();
    const messages: StaffMessage[] = [
      { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 2, oldest: at },
      { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [{ lane: 1, count: 3, oldest: at }], interim: 0 },
      { template: "moderation_burst", handle: "mod_anna", count: 20 },
      { template: "moderation_reads", handle: "mod_anna", limit: 200 },
      { template: "moderation_reveal", handle: "mod_anna", at, count: 1, limit: 10 },
      { template: "moderation_csam_lifted", handle: "mod_anna", at, what: "unsealed" },
    ];
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    for (const [index, message] of messages.entries()) {
      // Every other one finds no address that takes its mail.
      w.mailer.mode = index % 2 === 0 ? "deliver" : "fail";
      try {
        expect(await staffAlert(w.deps, `alerts-steps-${randomUUID()}`, MIN, message), message.template).toBe("sent");
      } finally {
        w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
      }
    }
    for (const message of messages) {
      const rows = await outboxSince(w.migrateDb, message.template, since);
      expect(rows, message.template).toHaveLength(1);
      const [row] = rows;
      expect([row!.priority, row!.scope, row!.step, row!.mailed_at !== null], message.template).toEqual([ALERT_KINDS[message.template].priority, ALERT_KINDS[message.template].scope, null, true]);
      // The push names nobody: the handle of the staff mail is not among its facts.
      expect(JSON.stringify(row!.facts), message.template).not.toContain("mod_anna");
    }
    const mailed = messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length);
    await round("off");
    expect(messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length)).toEqual(mailed);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind like 'moderation_%' and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz`);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the channel's health

  const beat = (beatMinutesAgo: number | null, mailboxMinutesAgo: number | null) =>
    w.migrateDb.execute(sql`
      insert into public.notify_state (id, beat_at, mailbox_ok_at, push_ok_at)
      values (1, case when ${beatMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${beatMinutesAgo}::int) end,
                 case when ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int) end, now())
      on conflict (id) do update set beat_at = excluded.beat_at, mailbox_ok_at = excluded.mailbox_ok_at`);
  const alarms = (since: Date) => w.migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: AlertFacts; mailed: boolean }>(sql`select kind, facts, mailed_at is not null as mailed from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable') and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz order by id`);
  const clearAlarms = () => w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);

  test("with NOTIFY off the channel is off, its check is skipped, and the tick still writes and mails the steps", async () => {
    await beat(null, null);
    expect(await channelHealth(tickDeps("off"))).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
    const at = new Date();
    expect((await round("off")).raised).toEqual([]);
    expect(await alarms(at)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a beat older than channel_down_minutes is down: alert_channel_down once in 24 hours, mailed by the next round, and the home screen says so", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();

    const health = await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"));
    expect(health.channel).toBe("down");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await round("on")).raised).toEqual(["alert_channel_down"]);
    expect((await round("on")).raised).toEqual([]);
    const rows = await alarms(at);
    expect(rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["alert_channel_down", true]]);
    expect(Date.parse(String(rows[0]!.facts.since))).toBe(health.since!.getTime());
    expect(mailsOf("alert_channel_down").length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    // Mailed only: the watcher publishes no row of this kind.
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_channel_down.legs).toEqual(["mail"]);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("on"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.alerts.channel).toBe("down");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a push still owed for longer than channel_down_minutes reads as down, and a row past push_owed_minutes no longer counts", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();

    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());

    // Every other row still owed is pushed meanwhile, as a working watcher would have: this file judges its own row.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where pushed_at is null and message_id is distinct from ${id}::uuid`);
    // 3f's review (operations3): while the watcher's last publish was taken or only throttled (push_ok_at fresh), ntfy
    // answers and the row waits for its turn: not down. Once no publish has worked for channel_down_minutes, it is.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.notify_state set push_ok_at = now() where id = 1`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");

    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("down");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.pushOwedMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    // The watcher works again for the tests that follow.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.notify_state set push_ok_at = now() where id = 1`);
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3f, Task 2: an order's steps (section 6.1, the rows marked 0025)

  /** A removal order of the migrator's in the transaction, received `minutes` ago, with an item open or disabled. */
  async function orderIn(tx: DbTx, minutes: number, options: { disabled?: boolean; open?: boolean; kind?: string; verified?: boolean; reasons?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, received_at, opened_at, opened_via,
                                       verified_at, reasons)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${options.kind ?? "tco_removal"}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`S-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true,
              now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), 'cli',
              ${options.verified ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${options.reasons ? "the authority's reasons" : null})
      returning id`);
    if (options.open ?? true) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 1, 'https://elsewhere.example/open')`);
    if (options.disabled) {
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, added_at, disabled_at) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 2, 'https://elsewhere.example/done', now() - make_interval(hours => 2), now() - make_interval(mins => 1))`);
    }
    return row!.id;
  }
  const orderRows = async (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ kind: string; step: number; scope: string; priority: number; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select kind, step, scope, priority, facts from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by id`,
    )).map((r) => ({ ...r }));
  const restart = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string, annexMinutes: number, clarifiedMinutes: number) =>
    tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'manifest_error', now() - make_interval(mins => ${annexMinutes}), 'cli'),
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'clarification_received', null, now() - make_interval(mins => ${clarifiedMinutes}), 'cli')`);

  test("order_due for an order: at remind_minutes and at the deadline while an item is open, the clock runs and the order is not closed; never for one given effect in full, stopped or closed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const remind = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      const partial = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1, { disabled: true });
      const full = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { disabled: true, open: false });
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now() - make_interval(mins => 30), 'cli')`);
      const closed = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${closed}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = (rows: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof orderRows>>) => rows.filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due").map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.itemsOpen, r.scope, r.priority]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, late))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, late))[0]!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(0);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, partial))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      for (const none of [full, stopped, closed]) expect(due(await orderRows(tx, none))).toEqual([]);
      // The deadline passes for the order reminded at remind_minutes: the second reminder, once.
      // The order and its first reminder an hour further back, as the hour would have passed.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = received_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}), opened_at = opened_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where order_id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([
        [0, 1, "all", 5],
        [1, 1, "all", 5],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a restart of an order's clock rings the phone on call again, as a message's first push, once a restart; a second restart alerts again", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {

      expect(first.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "on_call", 5, ["dueAt"]]]);
      // The first restart's row was written when it came, nine minutes before the second.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => 9) where order_id = ${order}::uuid`);
      await restart(tx, order, 5, 1);

      expect((await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail").map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // A stopped clock does not ring.

      await restart(tx, stopped, 40, 10);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now(), 'cli')`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, stopped)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail")).toEqual([]);

  test("order_unverified, daily: one count for orders given effect and not verified (or with an item added after the check), one for missing reasons, one for holds without an end", async () => {

    });

  test("3f Task 5: report_owed, daily, while a notification record is owed and was opened more than reportAlertHours ago, with how many and the oldest; none once it is sent", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      // Inside a transaction that ends in a rollback: no other file's owed record may count here.
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'report_owed'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.authority_notifications`);
      const record = async (hoursAgo: number) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at)
          values ('owed', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), now() - make_interval(hours => ${hoursAgo}), 'cli', now()) returning id`);
        return row!.id;
      };
      await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours - 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", since)).toEqual([]);
      const late = await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours + 2);
      await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", since);
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, typeof r.facts.oldestAt])).toEqual([[0, "all", 5, 2, "string"]]);
      // Sent, and the day over: nothing more.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'declined', declined_reason = 'not identifiable', closed_at = now() where id <> ${late}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'declined', declined_reason = 'a check that ended in no', closed_at = now() where id = ${late}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'report_owed'`);
      await steps(tx);

      // Every row of the record younger than the period, and no mark: nothing is overdue yet.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours - 1}::int) where chain_seq = (select min(chain_seq) from public.audit_log)`);
      await steps(tx);

      // The first row is older than the period, and nobody ever took a copy.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours + 5}::int) where chain_seq = (select min(chain_seq) from public.audit_log)`);

      // A fresh mark: the next day writes nothing; a mark older than the period writes the next step.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'copy_overdue'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (gen_random_uuid(), 1)`);

      await tx.execute(sql`update public.copy_marks set at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours + 1}::int)`);
      await steps(tx);
      const next = await outboxSince(tx, "copy_overdue", new Date(since.getTime() - 2 * 24 * 60 * MIN));
      expect(next.map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.hours])).toEqual([
        [0, hours + 5],
        [1, hours + 1],
      ]);

  });

    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);

});

        const kept = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [keptPlace] = await placesOf(tx, [kept]);
        const mine = [removal, kept, place!, keptPlace!, p.postId];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // The decision's rule and outcome rewritten: what the key confirmed is no longer what is stored.
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', through_seq = 0 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: category, throughSeq`]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = ${SPEECH}, through_seq = 1 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // Its measure taken out of the ledger: the decision no longer holds what its row lists, and the post's level no longer follows.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`, "post: its level is stored as removed, and the ledger of measures gives visible"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.moderation_apply(array[${p.postId}]::uuid[], true)`);
        // A text deleted, and a snapshot's content rewritten.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where digest = (select legal_reference_digest from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = 'another body' where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          "audit: its legalReferenceDigest names no saved text",
          "audit: the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest",
          `decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`,
        ]);
        // The other decision deleted outright, with what hangs on it: its row in the record now names nothing korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set answered_by = null, outcome = null where answered_by = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where decision_id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decisions where id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(keptPlace)))).toEqual([`decision: the audit row at place ${keptPlace} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 5: a decision that marked reports verifies with its marks, a mark taken out of the record or a row whose list was altered is reported, and a row signed before 3e reads its missing list as none", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const second = await intake(tx, ground.rule((await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId));
        const items = [first.recorded.items[0]!.id, second.items[0]!.id].sort();
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const q2 = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q2.postId));
        const plain = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [place, plainPlace] = [(await placesOf(tx, [marked]))[0]!, (await placesOf(tx, [plain]))[0]!];
        const mine = [marked, plain, place, plainPlace];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The params signed both marks; one taken out of the record as the migrator is a difference in `unfounded`.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
        // A row signed before 3e carries neither member: its missing list reads as no marks, its missing replaced as false.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' #- '{params,replaced}' where chain_seq = ${plainPlace}::bigint`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(plainPlace)))).toEqual([]);
        // And such a row beside a decision that holds a mark is reported: what was not signed is not what korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' where chain_seq = ${place}::bigint`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 7: a mark that korbat's own rules deleted is no difference: its report's day left the frame (the retention job's step) or its sender was forgotten (the account's purge); a mark deleted while korbat still knows its report and sender is", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const senders = [await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)];
        const reports = [];
        for (const sender of senders) reports.push(await intake(tx, ground.rule(sender.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId)));
        const items = reports.map((recorded) => recorded.items[0]!.id);
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, reports[0]!.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [marked]);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [marked, place!]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The first report's day leaves the frame: forget_report_counts deletes its mark, as the retention job does.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intakes set received_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where id = ${reports[0]!.intakeId}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update unfounded_marks set reported_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_report_counts()`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The second sender's account is deleted: its purge forgets who sent the report and deletes the mark with it.
        await authAccount(tx, senders[1]!.id, "0 seconds");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_reporter(${senders[1]!.id}::uuid)`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The third mark taken out by hand, while its report is in the frame and its sender known: that is a difference.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[2]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3f Task 6: it reports a gap closed as not needed without its confirmed audit row; an item whose disabling a restore lost is no difference while its gap names it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [gap] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, disposition)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 4, repeat('c', 64), 'case_decided', now(), now(), 'no_measure', now(), 'not_needed') returning id`);
        const [order] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_via)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'Bundeskriminalamt', ${`T-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true, 'cli') returning id`);
        const [item] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, disabled_at, preserve_until) values (${order!.id}::uuid, 1, 'sha256:x', now(), now() + interval '6 months') returning id`);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [gap!.id, order!.id]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          `gap: it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it`,
          `order: item ${item!.id}: it is recorded as disabled, and no measure of an order decision names it`,
        ]);
        await tx.execute(sql`
          insert into restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, acted_at, imported_at, class)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 5, repeat('d', 64), 'order_effected', 'order_item', ${item!.id}, now(), now(), 'order_effect')`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`gap: it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it`]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a post whose level the migrator set by hand, an image whose state was set, and a seal in force one of whose listed posts has lost an image row", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(removed.postId));
        await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const sealed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(sealed.postId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [removed.postId, sealed.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A removed post made visible again by hand, around the one writer of the level.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'visible', state = 'visible' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its level is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives removed"]);
        // The level put right and only the state left: the two must agree unless the author deleted the post.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'removed' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its state is stored as visible, and its level is removed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A sealed image shown again by hand.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'visible' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["image: its state is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives sealed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'sealed' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        // A sealed image row destroyed, which only the owner of the database can do: the keep trigger switched off first.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw("alter table public.post_media disable trigger post_media_keep"));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`delete from post_media where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[1]!}'`));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw("alter table public.post_media enable trigger post_media_keep"));
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`seal: it lists post ${sealed.postId} with 2 image rows, and the post has 1 now`]);
      });
    });

    test("the command itself reads on the API's role alone and exits 1 with what it found", async () => {
      // The shared database holds audit rows of decisions that earlier suites removed again, so the run is at fault or clean
      // by what they left; either way it reads, counts and answers, and the exit code follows its first line.
      const run = await cli(["text-verify"], { DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API! });
      expect(run.lines[0]).toMatch(/^(out text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: |err text-verify: FAILED, [0-9]+ problems? in )[0-9]+ confirmed rows, [0-9]+ decisions, [0-9]+ posts, [0-9]+ images and [0-9]+ seals in force/);
      expect(run.code).toBe(run.lines[0]!.startsWith("out ") ? 0 : 1);
    });
  });

  describe("access-request and an authority's demand (3f Task 5)", () => {
    test("a case whose notification record carries a running 'not to the person' is marked access.authorityHold in place of the lane-0 mark, with its day or an open end; one whose end passed is not; the handle's draft runs as the migrator", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const author = await one<{ handle: string }>(tx, sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
        // A seal opens the case's record; an authority then asks that the person is not told, with no end.
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const event = (caseId: string, until: string | null) =>
          tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, how, not_to_person, not_to_person_until)
                         select n.id, 'request', now(), 'a letter', true, ${until}::timestamptz from public.authority_notifications n where n.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        await event(suspect.caseId, null);
        // Two lane-0 cases with records the command line opened: one with an end ahead, one whose end passed.
        const second = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const ahead = await report(tx, aPost(second.postId), "rule", "R5");
        const third = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const passed = await report(tx, aPost(third.postId), "rule", "R5");
        for (const caseId of [ahead.caseId, passed.caseId]) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via) values ('owed', '{dsa18_1}', ${caseId}::uuid, ${p.authorId}::uuid, now(), 'cli')`);
        }
        await event(ahead.caseId, "2030-01-02T03:00:00Z");
        await event(passed.caseId, "2020-01-02T03:00:00Z");

        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContactsHere, (ids) => authorityHoldsFor(tx, ids));
        const cases = new Map(((drafted as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft.cases as { id: string; authoritiesCheck: string | null; authorityHold: string | null }[]).map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        expect(cases.get(suspect.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: null, authorityHold: ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold(null) });
        expect(cases.get(ahead.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: null, authorityHold: ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold("2030-01-02") });
        expect(cases.get(passed.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, authorityHold: null });
        expect(ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold(null)).toBe(
          "An authority asked that this person is not told of its request (no end given yet). Do not send this case's part of the draft, and do not say that an authority is the reason, before counsel has read it.",
        );
        // Without the migrator's reader nothing is marked: the API's role reads no record.
        const plain = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContactsHere);
        expect(((plain as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft.cases as { authorityHold: string | null }[]).every((c) => c.authorityHold === null)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a handle's draft runs in the migrate service: without the migrator's URL and APP_ORIGIN it is refused and drafts nothing", async () => {
      const lines: string[] = [];
      const code = await runStaffCommand(["access-request", "@someone"], { DATABASE_URL_API: loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API }, { log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => lines.push(line) });
      expect(code).toBe(1);
      expect(lines).toEqual(["access-request: a handle's draft runs in the migrate service, which holds DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE and APP_ORIGIN; nothing was drafted"]);
    });
    const noContactsHere = async () => [];
  });

  describe("access-request", () => {
    const noContacts = async () => [];

    test("for a handle: every case with its items' sources and grounds, its snapshots (an erased one without content, a sealed image by id and state), its decisions and appeals; the urgent cases marked; no reporter anywhere; one audit row of counts", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const author = await one<{ handle: string }>(tx, sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
        // Lane 2, closed without action, and its evidence erased: the snapshot is printed with its day and no content.
        const reporter = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const quiet = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(reporter.id), aPost(p.postId));
        const quietCase = quiet.items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decideIn(tx, mod, quietCase, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        await ageCase(tx, quietCase, "3 days");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${quietCase}::uuid)`);
        // Lane 0, closed: a report under R5 that an admin answered with a removal, which the author appealed.
        const second = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const threat = await report(tx, aPost(second.postId), "rule", "R5");
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, admin, threat.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
        await appealOf(tx, removal, p.authorId, "It was a joke.");
        // Lane 0, open: a report of child sexual abuse material about the account, its images sealed while deciding.
        const suspect = await report(tx, anAccount(p.authorId, author.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        // A new look at the first post, in a case of its own: its snapshot lists the two images, now sealed.
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        // The account's own report about someone else.
        const elsewhere = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const own = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(p.authorId), aPost(elsewhere.postId));

        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: `@${author.handle.toUpperCase()}` }, noContacts);
        expect(drafted.ok).toBe(true);
        const draft = (drafted as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft;
        const cases = draft.cases as { id: string; authoritiesCheck: string | null; closedAt: string | null; items: Record<string, unknown>[]; snapshots: { id: string; erasedOn: string | null; withheld: boolean; content: { body: string | null; media: Record<string, unknown>[] } | null }[]; decisions: Record<string, unknown>[]; appeals: Record<string, unknown>[] }[];
        const byId = new Map(cases.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        expect([...byId.keys()].sort()).toEqual([quietCase, threat.caseId, suspect.caseId, third.caseId].sort());

        // The lane-2 case is not marked; the two urgent ones are, the closed one too.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.authoritiesCheck).toBeNull();
        expect(byId.get(third.caseId)!.authoritiesCheck).toBeNull();
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, closedAt: expect.any(String) });
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, closedAt: null });
        expect(ACCESS_WORDS.authorities).toBe("check the R2, Art. 18 and order records before sending: an authority may need the person not to be told yet, or national law may restrict access (GDPR Art. 23(1)(d))");

        // Sources as categories, with ground, rule and category.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.items).toEqual([{ source: "a notice under Article 16", ground: "illegal content", rule: null, category: SPEECH, arrivedAt: expect.any(String) }]);
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.items).toMatchObject([{ source: "a report by another user", ground: "a korbat rule", rule: "R5" }]);
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)!.items).toMatchObject([{ source: "a notice under Article 16", ground: "child sexual abuse material", rule: null }]);

        // The erased snapshot: its day, and no content.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.snapshots).toEqual([{ id: expect.any(String), takenAt: expect.any(String), erasedOn: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), withheld: true, content: null }]);
        // A held snapshot with its content; each sealed image by id and state, and nothing more.
        const shown = byId.get(third.caseId)!.snapshots[0]!;
        expect(shown).toMatchObject({ erasedOn: null, withheld: false, content: { body: "a post" } });
        expect(shown.content!.media).toEqual(p.mediaIds.map((id) => ({ id, state: "sealed" })));
        // The decisions with their statement's data and texts, and the author's own appeal with its statement.
        // 3e: the removal under R5 gave the post its strike, which the draft lists among the decision's measures.
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: removal, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", rule: "R5", measures: [{ kind: "remove", image: null, noEffect: null }, { kind: "strike", image: null, noEffect: null }], facts: expect.any(String), reason: expect.any(String), legalReference: null }]);
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.appeals).toMatchObject([{ decisionId: removal, statement: "It was a joke.", result: null }]);
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)!.decisions).toMatchObject([{ kind: "interim", rule: "R2", measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] }]);

        // Under withheld: the identities, counted and never printed, and each text another person wrote, marked.
        expect(draft.withheld.identities).toEqual({ count: 3, reason: "rights of others: GDPR Art. 15(4), recital 63" });
        expect(draft.withheld.texts).toEqual([{ caseId: quietCase, kind: "explanation", text: "It breaks the law.", note: "send only after a person has weighed the writer's rights (C-203/22)" }]);
        const printed = JSON.stringify(draft);
        for (const hidden of [reporter.id, reporter.handle, quiet.intakeId]) expect(printed).not.toContain(hidden);
        // The account's own reports, as it sent them.
        expect(draft.ownReports).toMatchObject([{ ref: own.ref, ground: "illegal content", explanation: "It breaks the law.", items: [{ item: 1, link: `${ORIGIN}/post/${elsewhere.postId}`, shownOutcome: null, reexamination: false }] }]);
        // One audit row: the account, and counts.
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "access_request_drafted", p.authorId)).map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: "user", target_id: p.authorId, metadata: { cases: 4, contacts: 0 }, step_up: null }]);

        expect(await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: "nobody_has_this" }, noContacts)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "no account has the handle @nobody_has_this" });
      });
    });

    test("an R4 removal made final leaves no R4 text in the draft: the snapshots are printed without content and the post's body is gone", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const secret = `a home address ${randomUUID()}`;
        const [post] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, created_at) values (${author.id}::uuid, ${secret}, now() - interval '30 days') returning id`);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(post!.id));
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const draftOf = async () => JSON.stringify(((await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContacts)) as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft);
        expect(await draftOf()).toContain(secret);
        await ageCase(tx, caseId, "7 months");
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${removal}::uuid) as done`)).toEqual({ done: true });
        const after = await draftOf();
        expect(after).not.toContain(secret);
        expect(after).toContain('"contentErasedOn":"');
      });
    });

    test("for an address: the contacts the auth module found, each with the name it gave and its notices; the audit row names nobody", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const named = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const contactId = randomUUID();
        const intakeId = await insertIntake(tx, { kind: "user", channel: "signed_out", contactId, allegesIllegal: true, category: SPEECH, explanation: "This post is unlawful.", citedLaw: "Section 5", bonaFide: true, lookupHash: hex64() });
        await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId: await openCase(tx, "post", p.postId), targetId: p.postId, lane: 1 });
        await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId: await openCase(tx, "account", named.id), targetType: "account", targetId: named.id, position: 2, lane: 1, namedHandle: "as_named" });
        const [notice] = await tx.execute<{ ref: string }>(sql`select ref from intakes where id = ${intakeId}::uuid`);
        const asked: string[] = [];
        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { email: "notifier@korbat.local" }, async (email) => {
          asked.push(email);
          return [{ id: contactId, name: "Ann Notifier" }, { id: randomUUID(), name: null }];
        });
        expect(asked).toEqual(["notifier@korbat.local"]);
        const draft = (drafted as { draft: ContactsAccessDraft }).draft;
        expect(draft.contacts).toMatchObject([
          {
            name: "Ann Notifier",

    // No log line of the round carries an address, a handle or an account id.
    expect(JSON.stringify(lines)).not.toContain(p.authorId);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => row.metadata.step)).toEqual(["drafts"]);
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where case_id = ${made.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null and text is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 20 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });
    expect(counts.statements).toBe(1);
    // The mark comes off the profile again, so that the rounds of the other tests are not held to this refusal.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = null where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
  });

  describe("MODERATION_RETENTION", () => {
    /** A lock that says which keys were asked for, and resolves when one is let go. */
    function watchedLock() {
      const inner = new MemoryJobLock();
      const asked: string[] = [];
      const released = new Map<string, () => void>();
      const lock: JobLock = {
        acquire: (key, token, ttlMs) => {
          asked.push(key);
          return inner.acquire(key, token, ttlMs);
        },
        refresh: (key, token, ttlMs) => inner.refresh(key, token, ttlMs),
        release: async (key, token) => {
          await inner.release(key, token);
          released.get(key)?.();
        },
      };
      const until = (key: string) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => released.set(key, resolve));
      return { lock, asked, until };
    }

    test.each(["off", "on"] as const)("%s: after ten minutes the dispatch job's round runs, and the retention job's only while the switch is on; off, the warning is logged and a due case keeps its snapshot and a due R4 decision's post its body", async (setting) => {
      const p = await post(0);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      const state = async () => ({
        ...(await one<{ body: string; redacted: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select (select body from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid) as body, (select redacted_at is not null from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid) as redacted`)),
        snapshots: (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, made.caseId)).snapshots,
      });
      expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 });

      const warnings: string[] = [];
      const logger = pino({ level: "warn" }, { write: (line: string) => void warnings.push((JSON.parse(line) as { msg: string }).msg) });
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: { ...loadConfig(), MODERATION_RETENTION: setting }, logger });
      const { lock, asked, until } = watchedLock();
      // postgres.js opens a connection by setTimeout, which the clock faked below would never run, so a round that needed
      // a new one would wait forever: the pool's six connections are opened first, while the clock is real. Since 3f's
      // review the tick and its mail leg run side by side and take two of them in the first 30 seconds.
      await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => apiDb.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(0.05)`)));
      vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setTimeout", "clearTimeout"] });
      let stop: () => void = () => undefined;
      try {
        stop = moderation.startJobs(lock);
        expect(warnings.filter((line) => line === RETENTION_OFF_WARNING)).toHaveLength(setting === "off" ? 1 : 0);
        expect(RETENTION_OFF_WARNING).toBe("moderation-retention: off (MODERATION_RETENTION)");
        const dispatched = until("job:moderation-dispatch");
        const retained = setting === "on" ? until("job:moderation-retention") : Promise.resolve();
        // Nothing of these two runs before the ten minutes are over. 3f's alert tick and (since 3f's review) its mail
        // leg, which startJobs also starts in both branches, run every 30 seconds meanwhile.
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(RETENTION_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
        expect(asked.filter((key) => key !== "job:alert-tick" && key !== "job:alert-mail")).toEqual([]);
        expect(asked).toContain("job:alert-tick");
        expect(asked).toContain("job:alert-mail");
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2);
        await Promise.all([dispatched, retained]);
      } finally {
        stop();
        vi.useRealTimers();
      }
      expect(asked).toContain("job:moderation-dispatch");
      expect(asked.includes("job:moderation-retention")).toBe(setting === "on");
      expect(await state()).toEqual(setting === "off" ? { body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 } : { body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      // The author's decision screen: the copy while korbat holds it, and after the job's redaction the words of an R4 erasure.
      expect((await authorDecisionView({ apiDb }, p.authorId, removal)).content!.kind).toBe(setting === "off" ? "post" : "r4_redacted");
      // What the switch held back is made up by a round once it is on again.
      if (setting === "off") {
        await round(casesMedia(apiDb));
        expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      }
    });
  });

  describe("the purge's forgetting", () => {
    test("forgetAccount forgets the reports of an account the take-down marked deleted, changes nothing for a live one, and nothing when run again", async () => {
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: loadConfig(), logger: log });
      const { user } = await newUserWithDevice(createAuthRepo(w.authDb));
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${user.id}::uuid, ${`r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`}, 'Reporter')`);
      profilesMade.push(user.id);
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await recordIntake(moderation.deps, { ground: ground.rule(user.id), live: [aPost(p.postId)] });
      const linked = () => one(apiDb, sql`select (select reporter_id from intakes where id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid) as intake, (select reporter_account_id from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid) as item`);

      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: user.id, item: user.id });
      // The take-down's mark, as the auth role sets it; from then on the purge's step forgets the links.
      await w.authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${user.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`);
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      // The report goes on: its item still waits in its case.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid and outcome is null and case_id is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  describe("the erasures' races", () => {
    /** A signed-out notice of illegality about a new post, answered without action and released `ago` ago: no account stands on its items. */
    async function releasedNotice(ago: string) {
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.illegal(null), aPost(p.postId));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      decided(await w.decideAs(mod, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await releaseItems(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId);
      await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId, ago);
      return { ...p, caseId, intakeId: recorded.intakeId, itemId: recorded.items[0]!.id };
    }
    /** The re-examination's item, as the intake transaction inserts it, in a new open case of the post. */
    const reexamine = (db: Parameters<typeof insertItem>[0], n: { intakeId: string; postId: string; itemId: string }, caseId: string, marker?: string) =>
      insertItem(db, { intakeId: n.intakeId, caseId, targetId: n.postId, lane: 1, reexaminesItemId: n.itemId, marker });
    const openCaseOf = async (postId: string) => (await one<{ id: string }>(apiDb, sql`insert into cases (target_type, target_id) values ('post', ${postId}::uuid) returning id`)).id;

    test("a re-examination that holds the intake first makes the erasure wait, and the erasure then finds the intake not due", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("5 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let erasing: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        // The re-examination is inside its window, and its transaction holds the intake's row.
        await reexamine(tx, n, caseId);
        // Meanwhile the window runs out: without the new item the intake's record would be due.
        await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, n.intakeId, "8 months");
        erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid)`));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await erasing).toBe("not_due");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is null as held, explanation is not null as words from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ held: true, words: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("an erasure that holds the intake first makes the re-examination wait, and the re-examination is then refused: nothing is asked of an erased record", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("8 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let asking: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid) as n`)).toMatchObject({ n: expect.any(Number) });
        // The item's release is dated forward again while the erasure is still open: by the clock alone the window
        // would be open, so only the erased record refuses the request.
        await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_sent_at = now() - interval '5 months' where id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`);
        asking = refusal(reexamine(apiDb, n, caseId, marker));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await asking).toBe("reexamination_not_open");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is not null as erased from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ erased: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from cases where id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
    });

    /** A post removed under R1 seven months ago: its restriction is final for its author, and its case's evidence is due. */
    async function dueRemoval() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, caseId: made.caseId, removal };
    }
    const snapshotErased = async (caseId: string) => (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, caseId)).snapshots === 0;

    test("a correction that names the old snapshot and takes the case first commits before the erasure, which then erases the snapshot", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const release = gate();
      const held = gate();
      // Another session holds the post's row, which the correction's measure needs after it has taken the case.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from posts where id = ${r.postId}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into decision_actions (decision_id");
      const erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`));
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      release.open();
      await holding;
      const correction = decided(await correcting);
      expect(await erasing).toBeNull();
      // The correction committed naming a snapshot that was whole at its commit; the erasure came after it.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select (select decided_at from decisions where id = ${correction}::uuid) <= (select erased_at from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid) as before`)).toEqual({ before: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
    });

    test("an erasure that takes the case first erases the snapshot, and the correction that named it is refused: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`);
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the case, and that already waits for the erasure, which holds the case's row.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into staff_texts (case_id");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("a correction that names a snapshot taken in the last day commits, and the erasure is refused: the case is not due for a day", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const fresh = await one<{ id: string; digest: string }>(w.migrateDb, sql`
        insert into evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest)
        select case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid returning id, digest`);
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")], snapshotId: fresh.id, snapshotDigest: fresh.digest }));
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      expect((await evidenceLeft(apiDb, r.caseId)).snapshots).toBe(2);
    });

    /**
     * A post with one image and two closed cases. The earlier one removed the image under R1 eight months ago, and its copy
     * of the post was taken then. The later one removed the post under R4 seven months ago: that removal is final for its
     * author, so its redaction is due, and the earlier case's copy, taken before it, holds what it restricted.
     */
    async function dueRedaction() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const earlier = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const imageRemoval = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, earlier.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove_media", p.mediaIds[0]!)] }));
      const later = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, later.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, earlier.caseId, "8 months");
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, later.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, earlier: earlier.caseId, imageRemoval, later: later.caseId, removal };
    }

    test("the R4 redaction takes every case whose copy it erases before it erases one: it waits for a transaction that holds an earlier case of the post, as a decision on that case does, and erases that case's copy only afterwards", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      // A decision takes its case's row in this mode before it reads the copy it names.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from cases where id = ${r.earlier}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const redacting = one<{ changed: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`);
      try {
        // The redaction either comes to wait, or ends without waiting: then it erased the earlier case's copy beside
        // whoever holds that case, and a decision in that place would commit naming a copy erased under it.
        const first = await Promise.race([
          untilBlocked(apiDb, marker).then(() => "waited" as const, () => "never waited" as const),
          redacting.then(() => "ended without waiting" as const, () => "ended without waiting" as const),
        ]);
        expect(first).toBe("waited");
        expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(false);
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await holding;
      }
      expect(await redacting).toEqual({ changed: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.later)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select redacted_at is not null as redacted from decisions where id = ${r.removal}::uuid`)).toEqual({ redacted: true });
    });

    test("a correction of an earlier case's decision that names a copy the R4 redaction is erasing waits for the redaction at that case and is refused before it commits: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`)).toEqual({ changed: true });
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.earlier, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.imageRemoval, actions: [act("restore_media", r.mediaIds[0]!)] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the earlier case, and that already waits for the redaction, which holds
        // that case's row because it erases that case's copy. A redaction that held only its own case would let the
        // correction read the copy whole and commit naming it.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.earlier}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 5: the step authority_records runs before the disposal and erases the records to authorities that are due, with its audit row and a count", async () => {
    // As the migrator in a transaction that ends in a rollback, as the round's own steps run: the record's times can only
    // be supplied there, with imported_at, since every writer of the records is the migrator and the times are forced.
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const start = (await tx.execute<{ seq: number }>(sql`select seq::int as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`))[0]!.seq;
      const [old] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
        insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, closed_at, declined_reason, imported_at)
        values ('declined', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), now() - interval '3 years 2 days', 'cli', now() - interval '3 years 1 day', 'nothing to report', now())
        returning id`);
      const report = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log });
      expect(report.authorityRecords).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(report.failed).toBe(0);
      const [left] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.authority_notifications where id = ${old!.id}::uuid`);
      expect(left!.n).toBe(0);
      const steps = (await tx.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select metadata from public.audit_log where action = ${RETENTION_ACTION} and chain_seq > ${start} order by chain_seq`)).map((row) => row.metadata);
      expect(steps).toContainEqual({ step: "authority_records", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: report.authorityRecords });
      const names = steps.map((row) => row.step);
      if (names.includes("images")) expect(names.indexOf("authority_records")).toBeLessThan(names.indexOf("images"));
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 6: the step restore_gaps runs before the disposal, deletes a gap closed as not needed or imported 12 months on and keeps one a decision closed, with its audit row and a count", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const start = (await tx.execute<{ seq: number }>(sql`select seq::int as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`))[0]!.seq;
      const gap = async (disposition: "imported" | "reapplied") =>
        (
          await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
            insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, closed_by, disposition)
            values (gen_random_uuid(), 3, repeat('a', 64), 'case_decided', now(), now(), 'no_measure', now() - make_interval(months => ${ORDER_RULES.gapKeepMonths}::int, days => 2),
                    ${disposition === "reapplied" ? sql`gen_random_uuid()` : sql`null`}, ${disposition})
            returning id`)
        )[0]!.id;
      const imported = await gap("imported");
      const reapplied = await gap("reapplied");
      const report = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log });
      expect(report.restoreGaps).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(report.failed).toBe(0);
      const left = (await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.restore_gaps where id = any(${`{${imported},${reapplied}}`}::uuid[])`)).map((row) => row.id);
      expect(left).toEqual([reapplied]);
      const steps = (await tx.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select metadata from public.audit_log where action = ${RETENTION_ACTION} and chain_seq > ${start} order by chain_seq`)).map((row) => row.metadata);
      expect(steps).toContainEqual({ step: "restore_gaps", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: report.restoreGaps });
      const names = steps.map((row) => row.step);
      if (names.includes("images")) expect(names.indexOf("restore_gaps")).toBeLessThan(names.indexOf("images"));
    });
  });

  test("this file left no moderation row behind: what its tests committed is removed, and the moderation tables and the four auth tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, profilesMade);
    profilesMade.length = 0;
    // The two staff members' own rows go with the world; their decisions are gone with the cases above.
    expect(await moderationCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)).toEqual(beforeAuth);
  });
});
