import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, test } from "vitest";
import type { CaseDecidedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { insertAction, insertDecision } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld } from "../integration/moderation-decide";
import {
  aPost,
  act,
  anAccount,
  decisionParams,
  ground,
  intake,
  newImageRow,
  newPostRow,
  newTestStaff,
  raised,
  removeDecided,
  removeFixtures,
  report,
  staffProfile,
  type DecisionInput,
  type TestStaff,
} from "../integration/moderation-fixtures";
import { ageCase } from "../integration/retention-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "../integration/social-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "../integration/staff-fixtures";
import { ageOrderForTest, effectForTest, effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest, removeOrderAlerts } from "../integration/orders-fixtures";

/**
 * The contention lab of moderation decisions (3c design, sections 2 and 12): what a decision's transaction costs and what
 * it meets, measured against the real database with migration 0016. The lab issues the statements itself, as SQL: a
 * decision is its profile lock, its row and its ledger rows, whose triggers do the rest; a like, a follow, a deletion and
 * a purge are the statements the social and media repositories issue. Every measured transaction is rolled back, so the
 * lab leaves no decision. Its one audit row is the R4 removal that the redaction's rounds need committed, which is a real,
 * confirmed decision. The accounts and posts it commits for the two-session rounds and the large accounts are removed at
 * the end. It writes one line of JSON for each measurement, with how busy the machine's
 * processors were just before it. Run it by hand (see README.md); no suite includes it.
 */

/** Where the measurements go, one line of JSON each: the file LAB_OUT names, or lab-contention.jsonl in the repository's .data folder (the lab runs from apps/api). */
const OUT = process.env.LAB_OUT ?? path.resolve(process.cwd(), "../../.data/lab-contention.jsonl");
function line(name: string, result: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  const text = JSON.stringify({ name, at: new Date().toISOString(), ...result });
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(OUT), { recursive: true });
  appendFileSync(OUT, text + String.fromCharCode(10));
  console.log(`LAB ${text}`);
}

/** The share of processor time that was not idle over this many milliseconds, across all cores: how loaded the machine is. */
async function busy(ms = 1500): Promise<number> {
  const read = () => os.cpus().reduce((sum, cpu) => ({ idle: sum.idle + cpu.times.idle, all: sum.all + cpu.times.user + cpu.times.nice + cpu.times.sys + cpu.times.irq + cpu.times.idle }), { idle: 0, all: 0 });
  const before = read();
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  const after = read();
  return Math.round((1 - (after.idle - before.idle) / Math.max(1, after.all - before.all)) * 100);
}

async function timed(fn: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<number> {
  const start = performance.now();
  await fn();
  return Math.round(performance.now() - start);
}

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("lab: the contention of moderation decisions", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  const committed: string[] = [];
  /** The one thing the lab confirms with a real key: the R4 removal that the redaction's rounds make final again and again. */
  let world: DeciderWorld | null = null;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 8 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    const repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, committed);
    await world?.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A committed account with this many posts of one image each, written in bulk by the migrator. */
  async function largeAccount(posts: number): Promise<{ id: string; handle: string }> {
    const [id, handle] = [randomUUID(), `lab_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`];
    committed.push(id);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${id}::uuid, ${handle}, 'Lab account')`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, created_at) select ${id}::uuid, 'a lab post', now() - interval '40 days' from generate_series(1, ${posts}::int)`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) select ${id}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL' from generate_series(1, ${posts}::int)`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`analyze posts`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`analyze post_media`);
    // Each image goes onto the post of the same rank. The two numbered sets are joined by a hash: on fresh rows the planner
    // otherwise pairs them in a nested loop, which at 20,000 rows is 400 million comparisons.
    await migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local enable_nestloop = off`);
      await tx.execute(sql`
        with p as materialized (select id, row_number() over (order by id) as n from posts where author_id = ${id}::uuid),
             i as materialized (select id, row_number() over (order by id) as n from post_media where owner_id = ${id}::uuid)
        update post_media m set post_id = p.id, position = 0, alt_text = 'a lab image' from p join i on i.n = p.n where m.id = i.id`);
    });
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`analyze post_media`);
    return { id, handle };
  }
  /**
   * One decision's statements inside `tx`, each timed: the subject's profile lock, the decision's row, each ledger row.
   * The params are built before, as the console builds them before it asks for the key: their texts are saved rows.
   */
  async function decisionWith(tx: DbTx, staff: TestStaff, subject: string, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams) {
    const id = randomUUID();
    const lock = await timed(() => tx.execute(sql`select id from profiles where id = ${subject}::uuid for no key update`));
    const decision = await timed(() => insertDecision(tx, { id, caseId, decidedBy: staff.id, params }));
    const actions: number[] = [];
    for (const action of params.actions) actions.push(await timed(() => insertAction(tx, id, action)));
    return { id, lock, decision, actions };
  }
  /** The same, with the params built inside `tx`: for a single session, where nothing waits for what building them touches. */
  const decisionIn = async (tx: DbTx, staff: TestStaff, subject: string, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput) =>
    decisionWith(tx, staff, subject, caseId, await decisionParams(tx, staff, caseId, input));
  const withStaff = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
    rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });

  test("an account's seal at 1,000 and at 5,000 image posts, and the seal for good that follows it", async () => {
    for (const posts of [1000, 5000]) {
      const owner = await largeAccount(posts);
      const load = await busy();
      await withStaff(async (tx) => {
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, anAccount(owner.id, owner.handle), "csam");
        // A seal taken while deciding: one statement locks the account's image rows in id order, one row of seal_posts for
        // each post, and every image row is written once.
        const interim = await decisionIn(tx, mod, owner.id, caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        // The seal for good that answers the report: the answer ends the first seal (every image row written back), and
        // the second seal writes every row again.
        const final = await decisionIn(tx, admin, owner.id, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        // And its lifting, a correction: every row written a fourth time.
        const lift = await decisionIn(tx, admin, owner.id, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: final.id, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
        line("account seal", {
          posts,
          busyPercent: load,
          interimDecisionMs: interim.decision,
          interimSealMs: interim.actions[0],
          finalDecisionEndsInterimMs: final.decision,
          finalSealMs: final.actions[0],
          liftMs: lift.actions[0],
          challengeShare: `${(((interim.decision + interim.actions[0]!) / 600_000) * 100).toFixed(2)}% of ten minutes for the seal taken while deciding`,
        });
      });
    }
  });

  test("the purge of an account with 5,000 and with 20,000 image rows, free and frozen", async () => {
    for (const rows of [5000, 20000]) {
      const owner = await largeAccount(rows);
      for (const frozen of [false, true]) {
        const load = await busy();
        await withStaff(async (tx) => {
          if (frozen) await report(tx, anAccount(owner.id, owner.handle), "csam");
          const lock = await timed(() => tx.execute(sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${owner.id}::uuid for update`));
          // Every post of the account under a row lock, in id order, before any is written; then the tombstones. Both are
          // counted as "tombstones", as the one statement was that did both before.
          const tombstones = await timed(async () => {
            await tx.execute(sql`select id from posts where author_id = ${owner.id}::uuid order by id for update`);
            await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', deleted_at = now(), body = '' where author_id = ${owner.id}::uuid and state <> 'deleted_by_author'`);
          });
          const profile = await timed(() => tx.execute(sql`update profiles set display_name = 'Deleted account', bio = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${owner.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`));
          let deleted = 0;
          // The ordered delete by owner, as the media repository issues it, last: the keep trigger reads the freeze once for each row.
          const images = await timed(async () => {
            deleted = (await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id in (select id from post_media where owner_id = ${owner.id}::uuid order by id for update) returning id`)).length;
          });
          line("account purge", { imageRows: rows, frozen, busyPercent: load, profileLockMs: lock, tombstonesMs: tombstones, orderedDeleteMs: images, rowsDeleted: deleted, profileMs: profile, totalMs: lock + tombstones + images + profile });
        });
      }
    }
  });

  test("a decision against likes, follows, the author's deletion, the purge, an intake, an account's seal and a closing decision: forty rounds each, both orders", async () => {
    const [author, liker] = [await newProfile(apiDb), await newProfile(apiDb)];
    committed.push(author.id, liker.id);
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);

    // Committed once: the post's case under a rule, and its author's account's case on the path for child sexual abuse

    await staffProfile(apiDb, mod);
    await staffProfile(apiDb, admin);
    committed.push(mod.id, admin.id);
    const postCase = (await intake(apiDb, ground.rule(liker.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    const accountCase = (await report(apiDb, anAccount(author.id, author.handle), "csam")).caseId;
    const pause = (tx: DbTx) => tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(0.015)`);
    // The params of each decision, built and their texts saved once: every decision here rolls back, so its case keeps its
    // version and its texts stay unconfirmed, and the same params decide again in the next round.
    const withhold = await decisionParams(apiDb, mod, postCase, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    const removal = await decisionParams(apiDb, mod, postCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const seal = await decisionParams(apiDb, mod, accountCase, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    const answer = await decisionParams(apiDb, admin, accountCase, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });

    /** The decisions, each holding its locks for a moment before it rolls back. */
    const decisions: Record<string, (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "interim withhold of the post": (tx) => decisionWith(tx, mod, author.id, postCase, withhold),
      "final removal that closes the post's case": (tx) => decisionWith(tx, mod, author.id, postCase, removal),
      "account's seal, then the answer that ends it": async (tx) => {
        await decisionWith(tx, mod, author.id, accountCase, seal);
        // The answer follows the seal in the same transaction, so it names the case's next version.
        await decisionWith(tx, admin, author.id, accountCase, { ...answer, stateVersion: answer.stateVersion + 1 });
      },
    };
    /** What runs against them, as the statements the repositories issue. */
    const others: Record<string, (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      like: async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select deleted_at from profiles where id in (${liker.id}::uuid, ${author.id}::uuid) for key share`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = ${postId}::uuid`);

        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set following_count = following_count + 1 where id = ${liker.id}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set follower_count = follower_count + 1 where id = ${author.id}::uuid`);
      },
      "author's deletion": async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${author.id}::uuid for no key update`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', deleted_at = now(), body = '' where id = ${postId}::uuid and author_id = ${author.id}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set post_count = greatest(0, post_count - 1) where id = ${author.id}::uuid`);
      },

      purge: async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${author.id}::uuid for update`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select id from posts where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid order by id for update`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', deleted_at = now(), body = '' where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid and state <> 'deleted_by_author'`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set display_name = 'Deleted account', bio = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${author.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id in (select id from post_media where owner_id = ${author.id}::uuid order by id for update) returning id`);
      },
      "notice naming the post and its author's account": async (tx) => {
        await intake(tx, ground.csam(), [aPost(postId, 1), anAccount(author.id, author.handle, 2)]);

      "report under a rule": async (tx) => {

    const ROUNDS = 40;
    const load = await busy();
    for (const [decisionName, decision] of Object.entries(decisions)) {
      for (const [otherName, other] of Object.entries(others)) {
        const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
        let longest = 0;
        for (let round = 0; round < ROUNDS; round++) {
          const side = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>, delay: number) => async () => {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
            const start = performance.now();

              },

          // Each side starts first in half the rounds, a few milliseconds ahead.
          const ahead = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
          const [a, b] = await Promise.all(round % 2 === 0 ? [side(decision, 0)(), side(other, ahead)()] : [side(decision, ahead)(), side(other, 0)()]);

        }

      }
    }

  test("the R4 redaction against a decision that derives the post's level, a report that holds the post's images and a notice that locks them through the account: forty rounds each, both orders", async () => {
    // Migration 0018's redaction takes its decision's case, then the post, then the post's images in id order, as
    // moderation_apply and an intake do. A committed R4 removal, final for its author seven months ago, is redacted in a
    // transaction that is rolled back, so every round finds it due again.
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    const staff = await world.staff("moderator");
    const [author, reporter] = [await newProfile(apiDb), await newProfile(apiDb)];
    committed.push(author.id, reporter.id);
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
    for (const position of [0, 1, 2, 3]) await newImageRow(apiDb, author.id, postId, position);
    const r4Case = (await intake(apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    const removal = await world.decideAs(staff, r4Case, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] });
    if (typeof removal === "string") throw new Error(`the lab's R4 removal was not recorded: ${removal}`);
    await ageCase(migrateDb, r4Case, "7 months");
    // A second, open case of the same post, on which the other side decides: its measure derives the post's level.
    const openCase = (await report(apiDb, aPost(postId))).caseId;
    const withhold = await decisionParams(apiDb, staff, openCase, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    const pause = (tx: DbTx) => tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(0.015)`);

    const redaction = async (tx: DbTx) => {
      const [row] = (await tx.execute(sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${removal.decisionId}::uuid) as done`)) as unknown as { done: boolean }[];
      if (!row!.done) throw new Error("the redaction changed nothing");
    };
    const others: Record<string, (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "interim withhold on the post's other case (moderation_apply)": (tx) => decisionWith(tx, staff, author.id, openCase, withhold),
      "report under a rule, which holds the post's images": async (tx) => {
        await intake(tx, ground.rule((await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id), aPost(postId));
      },
      "notice naming the post and its author's account, which locks the images through both": async (tx) => {
        await intake(tx, ground.csam(), [aPost(postId, 1), anAccount(author.id, author.handle, 2)]);
      },
    };

    const ROUNDS = 40;
    const load = await busy();
    const single = await timed(() => rolledBack(apiDb, redaction));
    line("redaction alone", { images: 4, busyPercent: load, ms: single });
    for (const [otherName, other] of Object.entries(others)) {
      const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
      let longest = 0;
      for (let round = 0; round < ROUNDS; round++) {
        const side = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>, delay: number) => async () => {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
          const start = performance.now();
          const outcome = await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
            await fn(tx);
            await pause(tx);
          }).then(
            () => "ok",
            (err: unknown) => {
              const fromDatabase = raised(err);
              return fromDatabase ? `${fromDatabase.code} ${fromDatabase.message}` : (err as { code?: string }).code ?? String(err);
            },
          );
          longest = Math.max(longest, performance.now() - start);
          return outcome;
        };
        // Each side starts first in half the rounds, a few milliseconds ahead.
        const ahead = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
        const [a, b] = await Promise.all(round % 2 === 0 ? [side(redaction, 0)(), side(other, ahead)()] : [side(redaction, ahead)(), side(other, 0)()]);
        for (const [who, outcome] of [["redaction", a], ["other", b]] as const) counts[`${who}: ${outcome}`] = (counts[`${who}: ${outcome}`] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      line("redaction contention", { redaction: "redact_r4_body of a post removal", against: otherName, rounds: ROUNDS, busyPercent: load, outcomes: counts, longestMs: Math.round(longest) });
    }
  });

  test("3f, Task 4: the end of an order's preservation against the ten-item effect of the same order on the same author's posts: forty rounds, both orders", async () => {
    // Migration 0029's order_preservation_end takes the case of the item's decision (and those of the post's other
    // copies), then the item, then the post, then its image rows (design, section 5, the lock order, item 3); the effect
    // transaction takes the authors' profiles, the cases through its intake's items, the items' rows and then, post by
    // post, the snapshot, the decision and the measure. One order of eleven posts by one author: its first item was given
    // effect with a real key and aged past its six months, so every round finds its preservation due again; the other
    // ten are given effect in one transaction with a made-up confirmation of their params. Both sides roll back.
    const started = new Date();

    if (typeof done === "string") throw new Error(`the lab's first effect was not recorded: ${done}`);
    await ageOrderForTest(migrateDb, order.id, 200 * 24 * 60);
    const ten = done.items.filter((item) => item.id !== first.id).map((item) => item.id);
    const params = effectParams(done, { itemIds: ten });
    const pause = (tx: DbTx) => tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(0.015)`);
    const ending = async (tx: DbTx) => {

      if (!row!.done) throw new Error("the preservation's end changed nothing");
    };
    const effect = async (tx: DbTx) => {

      line("ten-item effect alone", { items: ten.length, busyPercent: load, ms: await timed(() => rolledBack(apiDb, effect)) });
      const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
      let longest = 0;
      for (let round = 0; round < ROUNDS; round++) {
        const side = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>, delay: number) => async () => {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));

            await pause(tx);
          }).then(

            (err: unknown) => {

              return fromDatabase ? `${fromDatabase.code} ${fromDatabase.message}` : ((err as { code?: string }).code ?? String(err));
            },
          );
          longest = Math.max(longest, performance.now() - start);
          return outcome;
        };
        const ahead = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
        const [a, b] = await Promise.all(round % 2 === 0 ? [side(ending, 0)(), side(effect, ahead)()] : [side(ending, ahead)(), side(effect, 0)()]);
        for (const [who, outcome] of [["preservation end", a], ["effect", b]] as const) counts[`${who}: ${outcome}`] = (counts[`${who}: ${outcome}`] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      line("preservation end contention", { end: "order_preservation_end of one item", against: "the ten-item effect of the same order", rounds: ROUNDS, busyPercent: load, outcomes: counts, longestMs: Math.round(longest) });
    } finally {
      await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, []);

  test("3f, Task 3: the ten-item effect of one order against an intake on its posts, a seal on one of its authors and the purge of the other: forty rounds each, both orders", async () => {
    // Section 13 asked for this part in Task 3, and 3f's review carried it to Task 8 (ruling 14). The effect transaction
    // (design, section 5, the lock order, items 1 and 2) takes its authors' profiles in id order, the cases through its
    // intake's items, the items' rows and then, post by post, the snapshot, the decision and the measure, whose triggers
    // take the post and its images. Against it: a report and a notice on its posts, which take the cases and the posts'
    // images; an interim seal of one author's images on the path for child sexual abuse material, which takes that
    // author's profile and every image of the account; and the purge of the other author's account, as the repositories
    // issue it. One order of ten posts, five by each author, given effect in one transaction with a made-up confirmation
    // of its params; every side rolls back, so every round finds the order as it was.
    const started = new Date();
    world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
    const staff = await world.staff("moderator");
    const [sealed, purged] = [await newProfile(apiDb), await newProfile(apiDb)];
    committed.push(sealed.id, purged.id);

    // account on the path for child sexual abuse material, sealed again in every round and rolled back. The moderator's
    // profile is committed once in the file, whichever test makes it first.
    const [hasProfile] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from profiles where id = ${mod.id}::uuid`);
    if (hasProfile!.n === 0) {
      await staffProfile(apiDb, mod);
      committed.push(mod.id);
    }
    const accountCase = (await report(apiDb, anAccount(sealed.id, sealed.handle), "csam")).caseId;
    const seal = await decisionParams(apiDb, mod, accountCase, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    const pause = (tx: DbTx) => tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(0.015)`);
    const effect = async (tx: DbTx) => {
      await effectWith(tx, staff, order.id, params);
    };
    const others: Record<string, (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "report under a rule on one of its posts": async (tx) => {
        await intake(tx, ground.rule((await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id), aPost(posts[2]!));
      },
      "notice naming two of its posts, one of each author, and the first author's account": async (tx) => {
        await intake(tx, ground.csam(), [aPost(posts[1]!, 1), aPost(posts[7]!, 2), anAccount(sealed.id, sealed.handle, 3)]);
      },
      "interim seal of the first author's images": (tx) => decisionWith(tx, mod, sealed.id, accountCase, seal),
      // As the repositories issue it: the profile, every post of the account in id order, the tombstones, the image rows.
      "purge of the second author's account": async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${purged.id}::uuid for update`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select id from posts where author_id = ${purged.id}::uuid order by id for update`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', deleted_at = now(), body = '' where author_id = ${purged.id}::uuid and state <> 'deleted_by_author'`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set display_name = 'Deleted account', bio = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${purged.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id in (select id from post_media where owner_id = ${purged.id}::uuid order by id for update) returning id`);
      },
    };

    try {
      const ROUNDS = 40;
      const load = await busy();
      line("ten-item effect alone (Task 3)", { items: params.items.length, authors: 2, busyPercent: load, ms: await timed(() => rolledBack(apiDb, effect)) });
      for (const [otherName, other] of Object.entries(others)) {
        const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
        let longest = 0;
        for (let round = 0; round < ROUNDS; round++) {
          const side = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>, delay: number) => async () => {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
            const start = performance.now();
            const outcome = await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {

              () => "ok",

              },
            );

          };
          // Each side starts first in half the rounds, a few milliseconds ahead.

          const [a, b] = await Promise.all(round % 2 === 0 ? [side(effect, 0)(), side(other, ahead)()] : [side(effect, ahead)(), side(other, 0)()]);
          for (const [who, outcome] of [["effect", a], ["other", b]] as const) counts[`${who}: ${outcome}`] = (counts[`${who}: ${outcome}`] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
        line("effect contention", { effect: "the ten-item effect of one order, two authors", against: otherName, rounds: ROUNDS, busyPercent: load, outcomes: counts, longestMs: Math.round(longest) });
      }
    } finally {

      `Lane 1: 1 case waiting longer than 24 hours, since ${TIME}.`,
      `2 replies to a suspension or termination have waited more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours, the oldest since ${TIME}. A reply sent before the start holds its suspension until someone answers.`,
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(replies);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { replyCount: "1", replyOldest: TIME }).text)[0]).toBe(
      `1 reply to a suspension or termination has waited more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours, since ${TIME}. A reply sent before the start holds its suspension until someone answers.`,
    );
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { replyCount: "2" })).toThrow(/replyOldest/);
    // A count without its time, and a mail about nothing, are programming errors.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2" })).toThrow(/lane0Oldest/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", {})).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });
});

describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours), earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to suspend your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat has decided to suspend your korbat account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet. The suspension starts ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`,
      `You can reply before it starts: sign in to korbat, where this decision is always shown and a banner on every screen gives the exact time and a Reply button. A reply sent before ${EARLIEST} is certainly in time, and holds the start until a moderator has answered you.`,
      "The decision and its reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day.");
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "terminate", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to terminate your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe(`korbat has decided to terminate your korbat account. Nothing is restricted yet. The termination starts 168 hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/window/);
  });

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {
    const kept = renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "kept", statement });
    expect(kept.subject).toBe("korbat answered your reply");
    expect(paragraphs(kept.text)).toEqual(["A moderator read your reply and kept the decision. The answer and its reasons follow.", ...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "reversed", statement }).text)[0]).toBe("A moderator read your reply and reversed the decision. The answer follows.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "withdrawn", statement })).toThrow(/outcome/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted for a withdrawal: never an answer to the reply, and the sentence on the reply only when one was filed", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "true", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat withdrew the suspension it announced");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat withdrew the suspension of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.",
      "The decision about the other measure reaches you separately.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "false", statement }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "korbat withdrew the termination of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account.",
    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has closed your terminated account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat's decision of 2026-04-04 09:30 UTC to terminate your korbat account is final: the time to appeal has passed, or your appeal was answered and the decision kept, and no reply of yours is unanswered.",
      "korbat has closed the account and is now deleting its posts and profile and every image it has not sealed, as that decision said. This cannot be undone. The handle stays reserved, so nobody else can take it.",
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    const sealed = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(sealed.text)[2]).toBe(
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images of yours that korbat sealed stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
    );
    for (const mail of [r, sealed]) expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|@[a-z]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
    // 3f (7.15 step 8): a termination's take-down holds the address as a deletion does, and its mail says so the same way.
    const held = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true", heldUntil: "2026-04-11", holdFinal: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)[3]).toBe(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.final("2026-04-11"));
    expect(paragraphs(held.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_USER);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 5: the statement mails of a warning about reporting and of a restriction of it (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {

    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat has looked at the reports your account sent under its rules and warns you about them. Nothing is restricted. The reasons, the reports concerned and what may follow are below.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);

  });

    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat restricted your reports under its rules");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat takes no reports under its rules from your account for 30 days, until 2026-11-03 09:30 UTC. You can still report illegal content. The reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { endsAt: "2026-11-03 09:30 UTC", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { days: "30", statement })).toThrow(/endsAt/);
  });
});

describe("3f: the staff mails whose words are their push's (W.4)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z";
  /** A kind's mail as the alert tick sends it: the row's facts as text, and the time it is sent, for the day of its times. */
  const mail = (template: TemplateName, facts: Record<string, string>) => renderTemplate(template as Parameters<typeof renderTemplate>[0], { ...facts, now: NOW });

      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],

      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],

    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {

      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));

      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);

    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",

    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");

  test("3f's review: every kind whose mail is its sentence is one the alert tick mails, and each has its template: Task 5's two daily kinds too", () => {

      const r = mail(kind as TemplateName, facts);

      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);

  const none = { served: 0, newestServedAt: null };

  test("a suspect item whose case reaches a served image: only a recorded choice not to seal ends it, and only for the images of posts created before it", () => {

    // A post with a served image created after the newest recorded choice starts it again,

    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ declinedAfter: false, newestDeclinedMs: 900 }), served(100))).toBe(true);

describe("the module's background work", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  /** The module over stand-ins that fail the test when a round touches them, and a lock that only records what it is asked. */
  function world(acquire: boolean, retention: "on" | "off" = "off") {
    const asked: { key: string; ttlMs: number }[] = [];
    const lock: JobLock = {
      acquire: async (key, _token, ttlMs) => {
        asked.push({ key, ttlMs });
        return acquire;
      },
      refresh: async () => undefined,
      release: async () => undefined,
    };
    const untouched = new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => Promise.reject(new Error("a round ran")) });
    const moderation = createModeration({
      apiDb: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["apiDb"],
      auth: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["auth"],
      social: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["social"],
      media: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["media"],
      rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(),
      config: { ...config, MODERATION_RETENTION: retention } as CreateModerationOptions["config"],
      logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });
    /** What the lock was asked for one job. */
    const of = (job: string) => asked.filter((entry) => entry.key === `job:${job}`);
    return { moderation, lock, asked, of };
  }

  test("startJobs runs the dispatch job under its own lock every ten minutes, from the end of the round before, until it is stopped", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    // Another instance holds the lock: this one asks for it at every turn and runs no round.
    const w = world(false);
    const stop = w.moderation.startJobs(w.lock);
    expect([DISPATCH_JOB, DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS]).toEqual(["moderation-dispatch", 10 * 60_000]);
    // The first round comes ten minutes after the start, not at once.
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
    expect(w.of(DISPATCH_JOB)).toEqual([]);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    expect(w.of(DISPATCH_JOB)).toEqual([{ key: "job:moderation-dispatch", ttlMs: DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS }]);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect(w.of(DISPATCH_JOB)).toHaveLength(2);
    stop();
    const asked = w.asked.length;
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3 * DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect(w.asked).toHaveLength(asked);
  });

  test("3f: startJobs runs the alert tick under its own lock every 30 seconds, also while retention is off, and stops it with the rest", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    expect([ALERT_TICK_JOB, ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS]).toEqual(["alert-tick", 30_000]);
    // 3f's review (operations2): the mail leg is a job of its own, under its own lock, at the same interval.
    expect(ALERT_MAIL_JOB).toBe("alert-mail");
    for (const retention of ["off", "on"] as const) {
      const w = world(false, retention);
      const stop = w.moderation.startJobs(w.lock);
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_TICK_JOB), retention).toEqual([]);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_MAIL_JOB), retention).toEqual([]);
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_TICK_JOB), retention).toEqual([{ key: "job:alert-tick", ttlMs: ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS }]);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_MAIL_JOB), retention).toEqual([{ key: "job:alert-mail", ttlMs: ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS }]);
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_TICK_JOB), retention).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_MAIL_JOB), retention).toHaveLength(2);
      stop();
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10 * ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_TICK_JOB), retention).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(w.of(ALERT_MAIL_JOB), retention).toHaveLength(2);
    }
  });

  test("3f's review: a relay that never answers holds only the mail leg: alert_steps() runs again every ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS while a mail waits", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const lock: JobLock = { acquire: async () => true, refresh: async () => undefined, release: async () => undefined };
    const asked: string[] = [];
    // A database that answers the tick's one statement, and for the mail leg one owed row and its claim.
    const execute = async (query: { queryChunks?: unknown[] }) => {
      const text = JSON.stringify(query);
      if (text.includes("alert_steps()")) {
        asked.push("alert_steps");
        return [{ written: 0 }];
      }
      if (text.includes("mailed_at is null and kind = any")) return [{ id: "1", kind: "report_owed", facts: { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" } }];
      return [{ id: "1" }];
    };
    const mails: unknown[] = [];
    const deps = {
      apiDb: { execute, transaction: async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => fn({ execute }) },
      // The relay: a mail that never returns.
      auth: { mailStaff: (message: unknown) => (mails.push(message), new Promise<number>(() => undefined)) },
      config: { NOTIFY: "off" },
      log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    } as unknown as Parameters<typeof createAlertTick>[0];
    const stopTick = createAlertTick(deps, lock).start();
    const stopMail = createAlertMailJob(deps, lock).start();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect([asked.length, mails.length]).toEqual([1, 1]);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2 * ALERT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS);
    // Two more rounds of the tick; the mail leg still waits for its first send and starts no second round.
    expect([asked.length, mails.length]).toEqual([3, 1]);
    stopTick();
    stopMail();
  });

  test("the queue-age alert has a key and a window of its own: once a day", () => {
    expect([WAITING_ALERT_KEY, WAITING_ALERT_WINDOW_MS]).toEqual(["moderation-waiting", 24 * 60 * 60_000]);
  });
});

```ts
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server } from "node:http";

/**
 * A stand-in for the push server (3f design, section 12, `fakeNtfy`): an HTTP server that records each publish (topic,
 * priority, tag, title, text and token) and answers 200 with ntfy's message JSON. It can be told to fail: to refuse the
 * next requests with a status, for a number of them or for a time, or to drop them without an answer; and to limit
 * requests as ntfy's visitor request limit does (3f's review, operations3).
 */
export interface Publish {
  topic: string;
  priority: string | null;
  tags: string | null;
  title: string | null;
  text: string;
  /** The bearer token the request carried, or null. */
  token: string | null;
  method: string;
}

export interface FakeNtfy {
  /** The base URL the publisher posts to, as http://ntfy:2586 is in the stack. */
  url: string;
  /** Every publish the server answered 200, in order. */
  published: Publish[];
  /** Every request, answered or refused. */
  requests: number;
  /** Refuses the next `count` requests with this status, or every request until `until` (a time in ms) when it is given. */
  fail(options: { status?: number; count?: number; until?: number; drop?: boolean }): void;
  /**
   * ntfy's visitor request limit (lab L1 measured its defaults: a burst of 60, then one more every 5 s): a bucket of
   * `burst` requests, refilled by one every `refillMs` of the server's clock, and a 429 with ntfy's answer once it is
   * empty; null lifts it. It applies before `fail`, as ntfy limits a request before it handles it.
   */
  limit(options: { burst: number; refillMs: number } | null): void;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

const read = (req: IncomingMessage) =>
  new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    let body = "";
    req.setEncoding("utf8");
    req.on("data", (chunk: string) => (body += chunk));
    req.on("end", () => resolve(body));
    req.on("error", reject);
  });

export async function fakeNtfy(now: () => number = Date.now): Promise<FakeNtfy> {
  const published: Publish[] = [];
  let requests = 0;
  let failing: { status: number; count: number | null; until: number | null; drop: boolean } | null = null;
  let bucket: { burst: number; refillMs: number; tokens: number; since: number } | null = null;

  const server: Server = createServer((req, res) => {
    void (async () => {
      requests++;
      const text = await read(req);
      if (bucket) {
        // Whole requests only: the time of a part not yet refilled is kept for the next one.
        const refilled = Math.floor((now() - bucket.since) / bucket.refillMs);
        if (refilled > 0) {
          bucket.tokens = Math.min(bucket.burst, bucket.tokens + refilled);
          bucket.since += refilled * bucket.refillMs;
        }
        if (bucket.tokens < 1) {
          res.writeHead(429, { "content-type": "application/json" });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ code: 42901, http: 429, error: "limit reached: too many requests", link: "https://ntfy.sh/docs/config/#rate-limiting" }));
          return;
        }
        bucket.tokens--;
      }
      if (failing) {
        const timed = failing.until !== null && now() < failing.until;
        const counted = failing.count !== null && failing.count > 0;
        if (timed || counted) {
          if (counted) failing.count = failing.count! - 1;
          if (failing.drop) {
            req.socket.destroy();
            return;
          }
          res.writeHead(failing.status, { "content-type": "application/json" });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ code: failing.status * 100 + 1, http: failing.status, error: "refused by the test" }));
          return;
        }
        failing = null;
      }
      const auth = req.headers.authorization ?? null;
      const topic = (req.url ?? "/").split("?")[0]!.slice(1);
      published.push({
        topic,
        priority: (req.headers["x-priority"] as string | undefined) ?? null,
        tags: (req.headers["x-tags"] as string | undefined) ?? null,
        title: (req.headers["x-title"] as string | undefined) ?? null,
        text,
        token: auth?.startsWith("Bearer ") ? auth.slice("Bearer ".length) : null,
        method: req.method ?? "",
      });
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json" });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ id: `m${published.length}`, time: Math.floor(now() / 1000), event: "message", topic, message: text }));
    })();
  });

  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve()));
  const address = server.address();
  const port = typeof address === "object" && address !== null ? address.port : 0;

  return {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
    published,
    get requests() {
      return requests;
    },
    fail({ status = 503, count, until, drop = false }) {
      failing = { status, count: count ?? null, until: until ?? null, drop };
    },
    limit(options) {
      bucket = options === null ? null : { ...options, tokens: options.burst, since: now() };
    },
    close: () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        server.closeAllConnections();
        server.close(() => resolve());
      }),
  };
}
```

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KIND_LIST, ALERT_KINDS, renderAlert, type AlertFacts, type AlertKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { createWatcher, type NotifyStore, type OwedPush } from "../../src/notify/main";
import { TOPICS, publish } from "../../src/notify/push";
import { fakeNtfy, type FakeNtfy } from "./fake-ntfy";

/**
 * The publisher (3f design, sections 5 and 7.1 step 5; invariants 14 and 15): every row still owed its push goes to
 * ntfy's topic of its scope with the publisher's token, its priority, its kind as the tag and the fixed text of its kind
 * filled from its facts, which hold counts and times only. A 200 marks it pushed; a 429 (ntfy's request limit) ends the
 * round's publishing and counts nothing (3f's review); anything else counts one attempt and is no cap: the row is tried
 * every round until it is published or past its bound, which is the database's to apply (notify-loop.test.ts). Without a
 * database: the rows come from a store in memory.
 */

const servers: FakeNtfy[] = [];
afterEach(async () => {
  await Promise.all(servers.splice(0).map((s) => s.close()));
});
async function ntfy(now?: () => number) {
  const made = await fakeNtfy(now);
  servers.push(made);
  return made;
}

const NOW = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");
const row = (id: number, kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts): OwedPush => ({ id, kind, priority: ALERT_KINDS[kind].priority, scope: ALERT_KINDS[kind].scope, facts });

describe("one publish", () => {
  test("goes to the topic of its scope, with the token, its priority, its kind as the tag, the title and the sentence", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    const facts = { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" };
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(1, "contact_mail", facts), NOW)).toBe("ok");
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(2, "moderation_waiting", { count: 4 }), NOW)).toBe("ok");
    const text = renderAlert("contact_mail", facts, NOW);
    expect(s.published).toEqual([
      { topic: "korbat-oncall", priority: "5", tags: "contact_mail", title: text.title, text: text.sentence, token: "tk_secret", method: "POST" },
      { topic: "korbat-all", priority: "3", tags: "moderation_waiting", title: "Cases are waiting", text: "4 cases or replies are waiting longer than their response time.", token: "tk_secret", method: "POST" },
    ]);
    expect(TOPICS).toEqual({ on_call: "korbat-oncall", all: "korbat-all" });
  });

  test("a refusal is push_refused, and a server that cannot be reached or drops the request push_connect", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    s.fail({ status: 403, count: 1 });
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), NOW)).toBe("push_refused");
    s.fail({ count: 1, drop: true });
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), NOW)).toBe("push_connect");
    expect(await publish(fetch, "http://127.0.0.1:9", "tk_secret", row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), NOW)).toBe("push_connect");
    expect(s.published).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("3f's review: a 429, ntfy's request limit, is throttled: neither a refusal nor a failure to connect", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    s.limit({ burst: 1, refillMs: 60_000 });
    const test = row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" });
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", test, NOW)).toBe("ok");
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", test, NOW)).toBe("throttled");
    expect(s.published).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("every kind with a push leg renders a push that names nobody: no @, no link, nothing but its words, counts and times", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    let id = 0;
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((k) => ALERT_KINDS[k].legs.includes("push"))) {
      const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
      for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = name === "at" || name === "since" || name.endsWith("At") ? "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" : 2;
      expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(++id, kind, facts), NOW), kind).toBe("ok");
    }
    expect(s.published.length).toBe(ALERT_KIND_LIST.length - 1);
    for (const p of s.published) {
      expect(`${p.title} ${p.text}`).not.toMatch(/@|http/);
    }
  });
});

/** A store in memory that owes the given rows and records what the round did with them. */
function owing(rows: OwedPush[]) {
  const owed = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
  const attempts = new Map<number, number>();
  const beats: { mailboxOk: boolean; pushOk: boolean; error: string | null }[] = [];
  const store: NotifyStore = {
    folderMark: async () => null,
    insertMessage: async () => undefined,
    setMark: async () => undefined,
    owedPushes: async () => [...owed.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id),
    markPushed: async (id) => {
      owed.delete(id);
    },
    markFailed: async (id) => {
      attempts.set(id, (attempts.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
    },
    beat: async (state) => {
      beats.push(state);
    },
  };
  return { store, owed, attempts, beats };
}

describe("the round's publish step", () => {
  /** A watcher whose mailbox cannot be reached at all, so a round is its publish step and its beat. */
  const watcher = (s: FakeNtfy, store: NotifyStore, now = () => NOW) =>
    createWatcher({
      store,
      imap: { host: "localhost", port: 9, user: "watcher", password: "secret", junk: "Junk", timeoutMs: 500 },
      push: { url: s.url, token: "tk_publisher" },
      fetch,
      now,
      log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });

  test("every owed row is published oldest first and marked; the beat says the push worked", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    const m = owing([row(7, "moderation_urgent", { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-16T08:30:00.000Z" }), row(3, "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" })]);
    const w = watcher(s, m.store);
    const report = await w.round();
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ pushed: 2, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" });
    expect(s.published.map((p) => p.tags)).toEqual(["contact_mail", "moderation_urgent"]);
    expect(s.published.every((p) => p.token === "tk_publisher")).toBe(true);
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(m.beats).toEqual([{ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" }]);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a refused row counts an attempt, sets push_refused and stays owed; the next row is still tried; nothing owed reads as a working push", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    const m = owing([row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), row(2, "moderation_burst", { count: 20 })]);
    const w = watcher(s, m.store);
    s.fail({ status: 500, count: 1 });
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: false });
    expect([...m.owed.keys()]).toEqual([1]);
    expect(m.attempts.get(1)).toBe(1);
    expect(m.beats.at(-1)).toEqual({ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: false, error: "push_refused" });
    // No cap: the next round tries it again, and it goes.
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: true });
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 0, pushOk: true });
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("ntfy away for four minutes and then answering: the owed rows go when it is back, without anyone touching a row", async () => {
    let clock = NOW.getTime();
    const s = await ntfy(() => clock);
    s.fail({ status: 502, until: clock + 4 * 60_000 });
    const m = owing([row(1, "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:59:00.000Z" })]);
    const w = watcher(s, m.store, () => new Date(clock));
    for (let minute = 0; minute < 4; minute++) {
      expect((await w.round()).pushOk, `minute ${minute}`).toBe(false);
      clock += 60_000;
    }
    clock += 1;
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: true });
    expect(m.attempts.get(1)).toBe(4);
    expect(s.published).toHaveLength(1);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("3f's review: a 429 ends the round's publishing there: the rest stay owed with no attempt counted, the beat says the push works, and they go as ntfy's bucket refills", async () => {
    let clock = NOW.getTime();
    const s = await ntfy(() => clock);
    s.limit({ burst: 2, refillMs: 5_000 });
    const m = owing([1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((id) => row(id, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" })));
    const w = watcher(s, m.store, () => new Date(clock));
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 2, pushOk: true, throttled: true });
    // One request past the bucket and no more: the rows behind it would only be refused too.
    expect(s.requests).toBe(3);
    expect([...m.owed.keys()]).toEqual([3, 4, 5]);
    expect(m.attempts.size).toBe(0);
    expect(m.beats.at(-1)).toEqual({ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" });
    clock += 10_000;
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 2, pushOk: true, throttled: true });
    clock += 5_000;
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: true, throttled: false });
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    await w.stop();
  });
});

describe("the watcher's exemption from ntfy's request limit (3f's review, operations3)", () => {
  /** What follows a marker in a file, up to the end of its line. */
  const after = (text: string, marker: string) => {
    const at = text.indexOf(marker);
    return at === -1 ? null : text.slice(at + marker.length).split(String.fromCharCode(10))[0]!;
  };

  test("notify has a fixed address on the push network, inside its default subnet, and ntfy's example exempts that address alone", () => {
    const root = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "..", "..");
    const compose = readFileSync(path.join(root, "infra", "compose.yml"), "utf8");
    const example = readFileSync(path.join(root, "infra", "ntfy", "server.yml.example"), "utf8");
    // ntfy resolves a host name only when it starts, before notify exists: the exemption names an address.
    const address = after(compose, "ipv4_address: ${NOTIFY_PUSH_IP:-")?.replace("}", "") ?? null;
    const subnet = after(compose, "subnet: ${PUSH_SUBNET:-")?.replace("}", "") ?? null;
    expect([address, subnet]).toEqual(["172.16.91.254", "172.16.91.0/24"]);
    expect(address!.split(".").slice(0, 3)).toEqual(subnet!.split(".").slice(0, 3));
    expect(after(example, "visitor-request-limit-exempt-hosts: ")).toBe(`"${address}"`);
  });
});

    expect(chipText({ decisionId: id(3), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false, strikeUntil: null, order: true })).toBe("Removed: an authority's order");
    expect(chipText({ decisionId: id(3), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false, strikeUntil: null })).not.toBe(ORDER_TEXTS.chip.order);
    expect(messageFor("not_appealable")).toBe(NOT_APPEALABLE);
    expect(ORDER_TEXTS.notice.noAppeal.startsWith(NOT_APPEALABLE)).toBe(true);
  });
});
