```ts
      const at = word === "none" ? null : instant(c, word);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set due_at = ${at?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "due_set", { dueAt: at?.toISOString() ?? null });
      return [at === null ? `${c}: no deadline.` : `${c}: due ${at.toISOString()}.`];
    }
    case "order-verify": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      const how = freeText(c, "--how", flag(cmd, "--how")!);
      const [row] = await rows<{ verified_at: string; items: number }>(
        tx,
        sql`update public.legal_orders o set verified_at = now(), verified_how = ${how} where o.id = ${order.id}::uuid
            returning ${isoOf("o.verified_at")} as verified_at, (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id) as items`,
      );
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "verified", { verifiedAt: row!.verified_at, howSha256: sha256(how) });
      return [`${c}: order ${order.id} verified at ${row!.verified_at}: ${row!.items} items compared with the order.`];
    }
    case "order-issued": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      const at = instant(c, cmd.positional[0]);
      if (at.getTime() > Date.parse(order.receivedAt ?? order.openedAt)) refuse(c, "an order is not issued after it was received");
      if (order.sectionC && (order.released || order.holdEndedAt !== null)) refuse(c, "the author's notice was already released, or its hold was ended");
      // While a notice of the order is held, a time stamp whose computed end is not ahead would release it within minutes,
      // which cannot be taken back: nothing changes then unless --release says that is what the order says.
      const [held] = await rows<{ held: boolean; would_end: string; past: boolean }>(
        tx,
        sql`select (o.section_c and public.order_hold_until(o.id) > clock_timestamp()
                    and exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i join public.decisions d on d.order_item_id = i.id where i.order_id = o.id and d.informed_at is null)) as held,
                   ${isoOf("least(public.order_hold_end(x.at, o.hold_extended), o.authority_hold_until)")} as would_end,
                   least(public.order_hold_end(x.at, o.hold_extended), o.authority_hold_until) <= clock_timestamp() as past
              from public.legal_orders o cross join (select ${at.toISOString()}::timestamptz as at) x where o.id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      if (order.kind === "tco_removal" && held!.held && held!.past && !cmd.flags.has("--release")) {
        throw new Refusal(
          `${c}: with this date the hold would have ended on ${held!.would_end}, and the author would be told at the next dispatch round. Nothing changed; give --release if that is what the order says.`,
        );
      }
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set issued_at = ${at.toISOString()}::timestamptz where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "issued_at_set", { issuedAt: at.toISOString(), release: cmd.flags.has("--release") });
      return [`${c}: issued ${at.toISOString()}; the notice is ${await holdWords(tx, order.id)}.`];
    }
    case "order-texts": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      const which = (["--reasons", "--redress", "--scope"] as const).filter((name) => cmd.flags.has(name));
      if (which.length !== 1) refuse(c, "give exactly one of --reasons, --redress and --scope");
      const column = which[0]!.slice(2) as "reasons" | "redress" | "scope";
      if (column === "scope" && order.kind === "tco_removal") refuse(c, "a removal order has no territorial scope of its own to record");
      const text = stdin!.toString("utf8").replace(/[ ]*$/, "");
      const max = column === "scope" ? ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.short : ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.long;
      if (!(text as string & { isWellFormed(): boolean }).isWellFormed() || hasControl(text, true) || FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(text) || text.trim() === "") {
        refuse(c, "the text from standard input holds a control or an invisible character, or no text");
      }
      if (Array.from(text).length > max) refuse(c, `the text has more than ${max} characters`);
      const salt = randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
      const digest = await textDigest(salt, text);
      await tx.execute(
        column === "reasons"
          ? sql`update public.legal_orders set reasons = ${text}, reasons_salt = ${salt}, reasons_digest = ${digest} where id = ${order.id}::uuid`
          : column === "redress"
            ? sql`update public.legal_orders set redress = ${text}, redress_salt = ${salt}, redress_digest = ${digest} where id = ${order.id}::uuid`
            : sql`update public.legal_orders set scope = ${text}, scope_salt = ${salt}, scope_digest = ${digest} where id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      // Task 3 (section 7.7, step 3): every told order decision of the order is owed its mail again, so that the dispatch
      // round mails order_notice_added: a time limit of the author's runs from receiving the authority's words. The event's
      // time is the recorded instant, which the notice prints; no column holds it a second time.
      const told = await rows<{ id: string }>(
        tx,
        sql`update public.decisions d set author_mail = 'pending'
              from public.legal_order_items i
             where i.order_id = ${order.id}::uuid and d.order_item_id = i.id and d.kind::text = 'order' and d.informed_at is not null and d.author_mail <> 'none'
            returning d.id`,
      );
      const [held] = await rows<{ held: number; until: string | null }>(
        tx,
        sql`select count(*)::int as held, ${isoOf("min(public.order_hold_until(i.order_id))")} as until
              from public.legal_order_items i join public.decisions d on d.order_item_id = i.id
             where i.order_id = ${order.id}::uuid and d.kind::text = 'order' and d.informed_at is null`,
      );
      // 3f's review (people2): the event names the text it wrote, so the notice says since when it holds the reasons.
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "texts_recorded", { text: column, digest, authors: told.length }, { ground: column });
      const head = `${c}: ${column} recorded (${Array.from(text).length} characters).`;
      if (told.length > 0) return [`${head} ${told.length} authors are sent an email that the notice has grown; the notice shows the text and this time from now.`];
      if (held!.held > 0) return [`${head} The notice is held: it will show the text once it is released, ${held!.until ?? "at a time not recorded yet"}.`];
      return [`${head} No author has been told of this order: the notice shows the text from its first telling.`];
    }
    case "order-document": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      if (stdin!.length === 0) refuse(c, "standard input held no document");
      const digest = sha256(stdin!);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set document_sha256 = ${digest}, document_bytes = ${stdin!.length} where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "document_recorded", { documentSha256: digest, documentBytes: stdin!.length });
      return [`${c}: ${digest}, ${stdin!.length} bytes.`];
    }
    case "order-scrutiny": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      if (order.kind !== "tco_removal") refuse(c, "only a removal order from another Member State is put to scrutiny");
      const step = cmd.positional[0];
      const at = instant(c, flag(cmd, "--at")!);
      if (at.getTime() > Date.now()) refuse(c, "--at is in the future");
      if (step === "requested") {
        const by = flag(cmd, "--by")!;
        if (by !== "korbat" && by !== "author") refuse(c, "--by is korbat or author");
        await recorded(tx, order.id, "scrutiny_requested", { by, at: at.toISOString() }, { effectiveAt: at });
        return [`${c}: request recorded.`];
      }
      if (step === "decided") {
        const outcome = flag(cmd, "--outcome")!;
        if (!(SCRUTINY_OUTCOMES as readonly string[]).includes(outcome)) refuse(c, "--outcome is upheld or annulled");
        await recorded(tx, order.id, "scrutiny_decided", { outcome, at: at.toISOString() }, { ground: outcome, effectiveAt: at });
        return [outcome === "annulled" ? `${c}: decided: annulled. An admin reinstates each item on its case, ground scrutiny, at once.` : `${c}: decided: upheld. The order stands.`];
      }
      return refuse(c, "say requested or decided");
    }
    case "order-reopen": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      const how = freeText(c, "--how", flag(cmd, "--how")!);
      if (order.closedAt === null) refuse(c, "the order is not closed");
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = null where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "reopened", { howSha256: sha256(how) });
      return [`${c}: order ${order.id} is open again. Its times are unchanged.`];
    }
    case "order-tell-rule": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      if (order.kind !== "dsa_art10") refuse(c, "only an order to provide information has this rule; a DSA Article 9 order's is its hold (order-hold-until)");
      const when = flag(cmd, "--when", false);
      if (when === null) {
        const fallback = settings.homeState === null ? null : (STATE_FACTS[settings.homeState as MemberState]?.tellPersonDefault ?? null);
        throw new Refusal(`${c}: the home state's default is ${fallback === null ? "not filled in" : fallback}; give --when to record a rule; nothing changed`);
      }
      const basis = freeText(c, "--basis", flag(cmd, "--basis")!);
      const rule: TellPersonRule = when === "at_effect" || when === "never" ? when : "at_instant";
      const at = rule === "at_instant" ? instant(c, when) : null;
      await tx.execute(
        sql`update public.legal_orders set tell_person = ${rule}, tell_person_at = ${at?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz, hold_basis = ${basis} where id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "tell_person_set", { rule, at: at?.toISOString() ?? null, basisSha256: sha256(basis) });
      return [`${c}: the person is told ${rule === "at_effect" ? "at effect" : rule === "never" ? "never" : `at ${at!.toISOString()}`}, on the basis recorded.`];
    }
    case "order-hold-until": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      if (order.kind === "dsa_art10") refuse(c, "an order to provide information has no notice of korbat's: its rule for telling the person is order-tell-rule's");
      if (!order.sectionC) refuse(c, "no notice of this order is held");
      if (order.released || order.holdEndedAt !== null) refuse(c, "the author's notice was already released, or its hold was ended");
      const word = cmd.positional[0];
      const at = word === "none" ? null : instant(c, word);
      const basis = freeText(c, "--basis", flag(cmd, "--basis")!);
      const how = freeText(c, "--how", flag(cmd, "--how")!);
      if (order.kind === "tco_removal" && at === null) refuse(c, "a removal order's hold has the Regulation's end: give the authority's instant, or leave its end as computed");
      // The end this record would leave (the lesser of the computed end and the authority's for a removal order; the
      // authority's own for a DSA order), and whether it is no longer ahead: that would release the notice within minutes.
      const [would] = await rows<{ until: string | null; past: boolean; computed: string | null; computed_wins: boolean }>(
        tx,
        sql`select ${isoOf("w.until")} as until, coalesce(w.until <= clock_timestamp(), false) as past, ${isoOf("w.computed")} as computed,
                   coalesce(w.computed < x.at, false) as computed_wins
              from public.legal_orders o
              cross join (select ${at?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz as at) x
              cross join lateral (select case when o.kind = 'tco_removal' then public.order_hold_end(coalesce(o.issued_at, o.received_at, o.opened_at), o.hold_extended) end as computed) c
              cross join lateral (select case when o.kind = 'tco_removal' then least(c.computed, x.at) else x.at end as until, c.computed) w
             where o.id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      if (would!.until !== null && would!.past && !cmd.flags.has("--release")) {
        throw new Refusal(`${c}: with this end the hold would have ended on ${would!.until}, and the author would be told at the next dispatch round. Nothing changed; give --release if that is what the order says.`);
      }
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = ${at?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz, hold_basis = ${basis} where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "hold_until_set", { until: at?.toISOString() ?? null, basisSha256: sha256(basis), howSha256: sha256(how), release: cmd.flags.has("--release") });
      if (at === null) return [`${c}: the notice is held with no end. Every staff account is reminded daily until an end is recorded.`];
      if (order.kind === "tco_removal" && would!.computed_wins) return [`${c}: the computed end ${would!.computed} is earlier and stands.`];
      return [`${c}: the notice is held until ${would!.until}.`];
    }
    case "order-hold-extend": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      if (order.kind !== "tco_removal") refuse(c, "only a removal order's hold is extended once; a DSA order's later time is order-hold-until's");
      if (!order.sectionC) refuse(c, "no notice of this order is held");
      if (order.released || order.holdEndedAt !== null) refuse(c, "the author's notice was already released, or its hold was ended");
      const received = instant(c, flag(cmd, "--received")!);
      if (received.getTime() > Date.now()) refuse(c, "--received is in the future");
      const how = freeText(c, "--how", flag(cmd, "--how")!);
      const [prior] = await rows<{ extended: boolean; console_at: string | null; cli: boolean }>(
        tx,
        sql`select o.hold_extended as extended,
                   ${isoOf("(select max(e.at) from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'hold_extended' and e.via = 'console')")} as console_at,
                   exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'hold_extended' and e.via = 'cli') as cli
              from public.legal_orders o where o.id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      if (prior!.cli) refuse(c, "the non-disclosure period was already extended once");
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_extended = true where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "hold_extended", { received: received.toISOString(), howSha256: sha256(how), confirms: prior!.console_at }, { effectiveAt: received });
      const until = await holdWords(tx, order.id);
      if (prior!.console_at !== null) return [`${c}: the console's extension of ${prior!.console_at} is confirmed; the notice is ${until}.`];
      return [`${c}: the notice is ${until}. It cannot be extended again.`];
    }
    case "order-hold-end": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      const reason = flag(cmd, "--reason")!;
      if (!(HOLD_END_REASONS as readonly string[]).includes(reason)) refuse(c, "--reason is not_authentic, annulled, released_by_authority or not_ordered");
      const how = freeText(c, "--how", flag(cmd, "--how")!);
      if (!order.sectionC || order.released || order.holdEndedAt !== null) refuse(c, "no notice of this order is held");
      // An extension the console recorded that turns out not to be the authority's is undone only once the first period
      // has ended: ending the hold before that day would tell early.
      const [first] = await rows<{ ahead: boolean; extended: boolean }>(
        tx,
        sql`select o.hold_extended as extended,
                   coalesce(o.kind = 'tco_removal' and o.hold_extended
                            and least(public.order_hold_end(coalesce(o.issued_at, o.received_at, o.opened_at), false), o.authority_hold_until) > clock_timestamp(), false) as ahead
              from public.legal_orders o where o.id = ${order.id}::uuid`,
      );
      if (reason === "not_ordered" && first!.extended && first!.ahead) refuse(c, "the first period of this extended hold has not ended: ending it now as not ordered would tell early");
      const [ended] = await rows<{ at: string }>(
        tx,
        sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = ${reason} where id = ${order.id}::uuid returning ${isoOf("hold_ended_at")} as at`,
      );
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "hold_ended", { reason, howSha256: sha256(how) }, { ground: reason });
      return [`${c}: the hold ended at ${ended!.at}. The next dispatch round tells the author, within about 10 minutes.`];
    }
    case "order-preserve-extend":
      return preserveExtend(tx, cmd);
    case "order-access":
      return preservedAccess(tx, cmd);
    case "order-told": {
      const order = await lockOrder(tx, c, cmd.order!);
      if (order.kind !== "dsa_art10") refuse(c, "only the person an order to provide information names is told this way");
      if (order.tellPerson === null) refuse(c, "whether the person may be told of this order is not recorded: run staff.js order-tell-rule first");
      if (order.tellPerson === "never") refuse(c, "the rule recorded for this order is that the person is never told");
      if (order.tellPerson === "at_instant" && Date.parse(order.tellPersonAt!) > Date.now()) refuse(c, `the person may be told only from ${order.tellPersonAt}`);
      const at = instant(c, flag(cmd, "--at")!);
      if (at.getTime() > Date.now()) refuse(c, "--at is in the future");
      const how = freeText(c, "--how", flag(cmd, "--how")!);
      await recorded(tx, order.id, "person_told", { at: at.toISOString(), howSha256: sha256(how) }, { effectiveAt: at });
      return [`${c}: recorded at ${at.toISOString()}.`];
    }
  }
}

/** order-open (section 8.11): the rows of insertOrder as the migrator, the alert order_opened, then the audit row. */
async function open(tx: DbTx, cmd: OrderCommand, settings: OrderSettings): Promise<string[]> {
  const c = cmd.command;
  if (settings.homeState === null || settings.appOrigin === null) throw new Refusal(`${c}: HOME_STATE and APP_ORIGIN must be set for the migrate service; nothing changed`);
  if (cmd.positional.length > 0) refuse(c, `${cmd.positional[0]} is not a flag of order-open`);
  const kind = flag(cmd, "--kind")! as OrderKind;
  if (!(ORDER_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(kind)) refuse(c, "--kind is tco_removal, dsa_art9 or dsa_art10");
  const state = MemberStateCode.safeParse(flag(cmd, "--state"));
  if (!state.success) refuse(c, "--state is the issuing Member State's two-letter code");
  const authority = OrderAuthority.safeParse(flag(cmd, "--authority"));
  if (!authority.success) refuse(c, "--authority is one line of 1 to 200 characters");
  const reference = OrderReference.safeParse(flag(cmd, "--reference"));
  if (!reference.success) refuse(c, "--reference is one line of 1 to 200 characters");
  const channel = flag(cmd, "--channel")! as OrderChannel;
  if (!(ORDER_CHANNELS as readonly string[]).includes(channel)) refuse(c, "--channel is mailbox, portal, post or other");
  const messageId = flag(cmd, "--message", false);
  if (messageId !== null && !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(messageId)) refuse(c, "--message is a message's id");
  if (messageId !== null && channel !== "mailbox") refuse(c, "an order whose message is listed arrived by mail: --channel mailbox");
  if (messageId !== null && cmd.flags.has("--received")) refuse(c, "a listed message's time of receipt is its own: give --message or --received, not both");
  const receivedWord = flag(cmd, "--received", false);
  const sentWord = flag(cmd, "--sent", false);
  const receivedAt = receivedWord === null ? null : instant(c, receivedWord);
  const sentAt = sentWord === null ? null : instant(c, sentWord);
  const links = cmd.flags.get("--link") ?? [];
  if (kind === "dsa_art10" ? links.length > 0 : links.length === 0) refuse(c, "an order to provide information takes no --link; the other kinds take at least one");
  if (links.length > ORDER_ITEMS_MAX) refuse(c, `an order holds at most ${ORDER_ITEMS_MAX} links`);
  if (links.some((link) => !OrderLinkText.safeParse(link).success)) refuse(c, "a --link is one line of at most 500 characters");
  if (new Set(links).size !== links.length) refuse(c, "a --link is named twice");
  const sectionC = cmd.flags.has("--section-c");
  // --section-c forces --withhold, as the console and the database do; a removal order always withholds.
  const withhold = cmd.flags.has("--withhold") || sectionC || kind === "tco_removal";
  if (messageId !== null && (await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select id from public.contact_messages where id = ${messageId}::uuid`)).length === 0) {
    refuse(c, `no message has the id ${messageId}`);
  }
  let items;
  try {
    items = await orderItemsFor(tx, settings.appOrigin, links);
  } catch {
    return refuse(c, "two links name the same post");
  }
  const id = randomUUID();
  const crossBorder = state.data !== settings.homeState;
  let inserted;
  try {
    inserted = await tx.transaction(async (inner) =>
      insertOrder(inner, {
        id,
        kind,
        memberState: state.data!,
        authority: authority.data!,
        reference: reference.data!,
        channel,
        messageId,
        sectionC,
        emergency: cmd.flags.has("--emergency"),
        crossBorder,
        withholdFromAuthor: withhold,
        openedBy: null,
        items,
        cli: { receivedAt, sentAt },
      }),
    );
  } catch (err) {
    const code = (err as { cause?: { code?: string; constraint_name?: string } }).cause;
    if (code?.code === "23505" && code.constraint_name === "legal_orders_reference_key") return refuse(c, "an order of this authority with this reference is already recorded (order_exists)");
    if (code?.code === "23514") return refuse(c, "a time of receipt or of sending after now is not taken");
    throw err;
  }
  const dueAt = kind === "tco_removal" && inserted.receivedAt !== null ? deadlineOf(inserted.receivedAt.toISOString()) : null;
  const entry = ALERT_KINDS.order_opened;
  const facts = { items: inserted.items.length, ...(dueAt !== null ? { dueAt } : {}), unknown: kind === "tco_removal" && inserted.receivedAt === null ? 1 : 0 };
  await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, facts, order_id)
                       values ('order_opened', ${entry.priority}::smallint, ${entry.scope}, ${JSON.stringify(facts)}::text::jsonb, ${id}::uuid)`);
  await appendAuditRow(tx, {
    actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
    action: "order_opened",
    targetType: "order",
    targetId: id,
    requestId: null,
    metadata: {
      kind,
      memberState: state.data,
      authority: authority.data,
      reference: reference.data,
      channel: inserted.channel,
      messageId,
      receivedAt: inserted.receivedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      sentAt: inserted.sentAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      openedAt: inserted.openedAt.toISOString(),
      sectionC,
      emergency: cmd.flags.has("--emergency"),
      crossBorder,
      withholdFromAuthor: inserted.withholdFromAuthor,
      via: "cli",
      items: inserted.items.map((item) =>
        item.postId !== null
          ? { itemId: item.id, position: item.position, addedAt: item.addedAt.toISOString(), postId: item.postId }
          : { itemId: item.id, position: item.position, addedAt: item.addedAt.toISOString(), linkSha256: sha256(item.link), linkLength: Array.from(item.link).length },
      ),
    },
  });
  const noPost = inserted.items.filter((item) => item.postId === null).length;
  const head = `${c}: order ${id} opened: ${kind}, ${state.data}, reference ${reference.data}, ${inserted.items.length} items (${noPost} name no post).`;
  if (inserted.receivedAt === null) return [`${head} Receipt not recorded: the console says deadline unknown.`];
  return [dueAt === null ? `${head} Receipt: ${inserted.receivedAt.toISOString()}.` : `${head} Receipt: ${inserted.receivedAt.toISOString()}; deadline ${dueAt}.`];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- preservation (Task 4; design, sections 7.11 and 8.11)

export const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/** The facts of an order's item that the two preservation commands read under the item's row lock. */
interface PreservedItem {
  id: string;
  orderId: string;
  postId: string | null;
  decisionId: string | null;
  preserveUntil: string | null;
  /** Whether the preservation runs now: post_preserved's test for this item. */
  running: boolean;
  ended: boolean;
}

/** The item a command names, under the given row lock, or null when no item has the id. */
async function lockItem(tx: DbTx, name: string, lock: "update" | "share"): Promise<PreservedItem | null> {
  if (!UUID.test(name)) return null;
  await tx.execute(
    lock === "update" ? sql`select 1 from public.legal_order_items where id = ${name}::uuid for update` : sql`select 1 from public.legal_order_items where id = ${name}::uuid for share`,
  );
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    tx,
    sql`select i.id, i.order_id, i.post_id, i.decision_id, ${isoOf("i.preserve_until")} as preserve_until,
               coalesce(i.preserve_until > now() and i.preserve_ended_at is null, false) as running, i.preserve_ended_at is not null as ended
          from public.legal_order_items i where i.id = ${name}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    orderId: row.order_id as string,
    postId: row.post_id as string | null,
    decisionId: row.decision_id as string | null,
    preserveUntil: row.preserve_until as string | null,
    running: row.running as boolean,
    ended: row.ended as boolean,
  };
}

/** The refusal of a command on an item whose preservation does not run (the design's word not_preserved). */
const notPreserved = (command: string, name: string): never => refuse(command, `not_preserved: item ${name} is not preserved, or its preservation has ended`);

/**
 * order-preserve-extend: an authority's or a court's request to keep a preserved post longer (TCO Art. 6(2)). Under the
 * item's row lock, on an item whose preservation has not ended (its time may have passed while the retention job has
 * not yet ended it), it moves preserve_until forward, never back, records the event preservation_extended with the
 * item and the time the request was received, and ends with order_recorded: who asked and their reference as given,
 * the proceedings only as a digest.
 */
async function preserveExtend(tx: DbTx, cmd: OrderCommand): Promise<string[]> {
  const c = cmd.command;
  const until = instant(c, flag(cmd, "--until")!);
  const by = freeText(c, "--by", flag(cmd, "--by")!);
  const reference = freeText(c, "--reference", flag(cmd, "--reference")!);
  const proceedings = freeText(c, "--proceedings", flag(cmd, "--proceedings")!);
  const received = instant(c, flag(cmd, "--received")!);
  if (received.getTime() > Date.now()) refuse(c, "--received is in the future");
  const item = await lockItem(tx, cmd.order!, "update");
  if (!item || item.preserveUntil === null || item.ended) return notPreserved(c, cmd.order!);
  const was = item.preserveUntil;
  if (until.getTime() <= Date.parse(was)) refuse(c, `--until is not later than the preservation's end, ${was}`);
  const [moved] = await rows<{ until: string }>(
    tx,
    sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_until = ${until.toISOString()}::timestamptz where id = ${item.id}::uuid returning ${isoOf("preserve_until")} as until`,
  );
  await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, effective_at, via)
                       values (${item.orderId}::uuid, ${item.id}::uuid, 'preservation_extended', ${received.toISOString()}::timestamptz, 'cli')`);
  await appendAuditRow(tx, {
    actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
    action: "order_recorded",
    targetType: "order",
    targetId: item.orderId,
    requestId: null,
    metadata: { event: "preservation_extended", itemId: item.id, until: moved!.until, was, received: received.toISOString(), by, reference, proceedingsSha256: sha256(proceedings) },
  });
  return [`${c}: item ${item.id} is preserved until ${moved!.until} (was ${was}).`];
}

/**
 * order-access: preserved content opened for a purpose of TCO Art. 6(3), only from here (no console screen and no route
 * opens it). Under the item's share lock, on an item whose preservation runs, it prints the preserved copy's text (the
 * snapshot the effect took, else the post's newest copy), its alt texts and the images' ids, pixel sizes and creation
 * times through the media module's preservedImages, never an image, and records the access as preserved_accessed with
 * the purpose and the counts. An access for an authority is a production (sections 6.5 and 7.14, Task 5): the command
 * then takes the authority's name and reference, opens a production of the instrument preserved_access for the order's
 * item and the post's author, by kind (`content`) and never by value, and names it in the audit row.
 */
async function preservedAccess(tx: DbTx, cmd: OrderCommand): Promise<string[]> {
  const c = cmd.command;
  const purpose = flag(cmd, "--purpose")!;
  if (!(ACCESS_PURPOSES as readonly string[]).includes(purpose)) refuse(c, "--purpose is review, complaint or authority");
  const forWhat = freeText(c, "--for", flag(cmd, "--for")!);
  // An authority's name and reference, as an order's are typed: one line each, under the contracts' bounds.
  const authority = purpose === "authority" ? authorityText(c, "--authority", flag(cmd, "--authority")!) : null;
  const reference = purpose === "authority" ? authorityText(c, "--reference", flag(cmd, "--reference")!) : null;
  const item = await lockItem(tx, cmd.order!, "share");
  if (!item || !item.running || item.postId === null) return notPreserved(c, cmd.order!);
  let productionId: string | null = null;
  if (purpose === "authority") {
    const [made] = await rows<{ id: string }>(
      tx,
      sql`insert into public.productions (instrument, order_id, order_item_id, account_id, purpose, authority, their_reference, produced, opened_at)
          values ('preserved_access', ${item.orderId}::uuid, ${item.id}::uuid, (select p.author_id from public.posts p where p.id = ${item.postId}::uuid),
                  'authority', ${authority}, ${reference}, '{content}', now())
          returning id`,
    );
    productionId = made!.id;
  }
  // The copy the effect took, which the item's decision names; else the post's newest copy that is not erased.
  const [copy] = await rows<{ taken_at: string; body: string | null; media: { id: string; alt: string | null }[] | null }>(
    tx,
    sql`select ${isoOf("s.taken_at")} as taken_at, s.body, s.media
          from public.evidence_snapshots s
         where s.target_type = 'post' and s.target_id = ${item.postId}::uuid and s.erased_at is null
         order by coalesce(s.id = (select d.snapshot_id from public.decisions d where d.id = ${item.decisionId}::uuid), false) desc, s.taken_at desc, s.id
         limit 1`,
  );
  const images = await preservedImages(tx, item.postId);
  const text = copy?.body ?? null;
  const media = copy?.media ?? [];
  const alts = media.filter((image) => image.alt !== null && image.alt !== "");
  await appendAuditRow(tx, {
    actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
    action: "preserved_accessed",
    targetType: "order_item",
    targetId: item.id,
    requestId: null,
    // The purpose and the counts; the words of --for only as their digest, and never a word of the content.
    metadata: { purpose, productionId, forSha256: sha256(forWhat), images: images.length, altTexts: alts.length, textLength: text === null ? 0 : Array.from(text).length },
  });
  const lines = [productionId === null ? `${c}: recorded, purpose ${purpose}.` : `${c}: recorded, purpose ${purpose}, production ${productionId}.`];
  if (copy === undefined) lines.push(`${c}: no copy of the post's text is kept.`);
  else {
    // The author's text as it was copied, between two marker lines, each of its own lines as it stands.
    lines.push(`${c}: ----- the text of post ${item.postId}, as copied at ${copy.taken_at} -----`);
    lines.push(...(text ?? "").split(String.fromCharCode(10)));
    lines.push(`${c}: ----- end of the text -----`);
  }
  media.forEach((image, index) => {
    if (image.alt !== null && image.alt !== "") lines.push(`${c}: alt text of image ${index + 1}: ${image.alt}`);
  });
  for (const image of images) lines.push(`${c}: image ${image.id}: ${image.width ?? "?"} x ${image.height ?? "?"} pixels, created ${image.createdAt.toISOString()}`);
  return lines;
}
```

### Replace `apps/api/src/cli/staff-cases.ts` (whole file)

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line's commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13): link, unlink, limits, text-verify
 * and access-request (3f's notification-facts, in records.ts, replaces account-facts). staff.ts parses their arguments,
 * reads their settings and opens their connections;
 * this file holds what each does, over the connections it is handed. Each sets the 10-second lock timeout in every
 * transaction it opens, writes its audit row in the transaction of its change and as that transaction's last statement
 * (the insert holds the chain's head until the commit), and says so when it changed nothing it was asked to.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { ALERT_KINDS, MEASURE_KINDS, snapshotDigest, textDigest, type SnapshotDigestInput } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { moderationLimits, profiles, staffPersonalAccounts, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { imageModerationStates } from "../media";
import { accessDraftForAccount, accessDraftForContacts, type AccountAccessDraft, type ContactsAccessDraft } from "../moderation";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../staff";

/** What a command reads and writes through: its own connection, or a transaction a test hands in. */
type Runner = Db | DbTx;

const rowsOf = async <T>(q: Runner, query: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<T[]> => (await q.execute(query)) as unknown as T[];
const uuidArray = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;
const textArray = (values: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${values.join(",")}}`}::text[]`;

/** Runs `change` in a transaction that waits at most 10 seconds for a lock, as every staff command waits. */
function changing<T>(db: Runner, change: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    return change(tx);
  });
}

/** A handle as the operator types it, with or without its at sign, in the lower case the profiles hold. */
export const handleArg = (arg: string): string => arg.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- link and unlink

export type Changed = { ok: true; lines: string[] } | { ok: false; problem: string };

/**
 * Records, or with `remove` takes back, that a personal account is a staff member's own (the recusal check of 3c reads
 * the links; no API role can). As the migrator, in one transaction: the staff account's row and the personal account's
 * are locked FOR SHARE, so neither can be promoted, demoted or taken down under the check; a link is recorded only for
 * a live staff account and a live account that is not staff. The audit row names the staff account and nothing of the
 * link, which must not spread.
 */
export async function changeLink(migrateDb: Runner, staffEmail: string, personalHandle: string, remove: boolean): Promise<Changed> {
  const handle = handleArg(personalHandle);
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const [staff] = await tx
      .select({ id: users.id, role: users.role })
      .from(users)
      .where(and(sql`lower(${users.email}) = lower(${staffEmail})`, isNull(users.deletedAt)))
      .limit(1)
      .for("share");
    if (!staff) return { ok: false, problem: `no live account for ${staffEmail}` };
    const [profile] = await tx.select({ id: profiles.id }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    if (remove) {
      const gone = await tx.delete(staffPersonalAccounts).where(and(eq(staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId, staff.id), eq(staffPersonalAccounts.personalUserId, profile.id))).returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
      if (gone.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
      await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_removed", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
      return { ok: true, lines: [`unlink: @${handle} is no longer linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
    }
    if (staff.role === "user") return { ok: false, problem: `${staffEmail} is not staff (its role is user)` };
    const [personal] = await tx.select({ id: users.id, role: users.role, deletedAt: users.deletedAt }).from(users).where(eq(users.id, profile.id)).limit(1).for("share");
    if (!personal || personal.deletedAt !== null) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not a live account` };
    if (personal.id === staff.id) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is the staff account itself, which is always a party where it is one` };
    if (personal.role !== "user") return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is a staff account (its role is ${personal.role}); only a personal account is linked` };
    const added = await tx.insert(staffPersonalAccounts).values({ staffUserId: staff.id, personalUserId: personal.id }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
    if (added.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is already linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_added", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`link: @${handle} is linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- limits

/** The five limits on staff, in the order the command takes them. */
export interface StaffLimits {
  decisionsPerHour: number;
  decisionsPerDay: number;
  caseOpensPerDay: number;
  findingsPerDay: number;
  revealsPerDay: number;
}

const describeLimits = (l: StaffLimits) => `${l.decisionsPerHour} decisions an hour, ${l.decisionsPerDay} decisions a day, ${l.caseOpensPerDay} case opens a day, ${l.findingsPerDay} findings a day, ${l.revealsPerDay} reveals a day`;

/**
 * Sets the limits' one row, as the migrator: an upsert, so it also works on a database whose row is missing, that
 * changes the row only when one of the five numbers differs. Its audit row carries the five numbers and is written only
 * when the row was inserted or changed.
 */
export async function setLimits(migrateDb: Runner, limits: StaffLimits): Promise<Changed> {
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const l = moderationLimits;
    const written = await tx
      .insert(l)
      .values({ id: 1, ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: l.id,
        set: { ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` },
        setWhere: sql`(${l.decisionsPerHour}, ${l.decisionsPerDay}, ${l.caseOpensPerDay}, ${l.findingsPerDay}, ${l.revealsPerDay}) is distinct from
                      (${limits.decisionsPerHour}::int, ${limits.decisionsPerDay}::int, ${limits.caseOpensPerDay}::int, ${limits.findingsPerDay}::int, ${limits.revealsPerDay}::int)`,
      })
      .returning({ id: l.id });
    if (written.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `the limits already are ${describeLimits(limits)}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "moderation_limits_set", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { ...limits } });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`limits: set to ${describeLimits(limits)}. Keep these numbers in your own records: a restore brings back the ones of its backup.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- alert-test

/**
 * 3f's review (operations6): alert-test [--on-call], the test push that the runbook's hand-over of the on-call phone and
 * its upgrade of ntfy ask for, since nobody on call can publish: the phones only subscribe. One alert_test row, to every
 * staff phone or (--on-call) to the phone on call alone, with its time, which the watcher publishes at its next round,
 * and the audit row alert_test_sent with the scope. A row of this kind is pushed only and never mailed.
 */
export async function alertTest(migrateDb: Runner, onCall: boolean): Promise<Changed> {
  const scope = onCall ? "on_call" : "all";
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, facts)
                         values ('alert_test', ${ALERT_KINDS.alert_test.priority}, ${scope}, jsonb_build_object('at', public.alert_time(now())))`);
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "alert_test_sent", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { scope } });
    return {
      ok: true,
      lines: [`alert-test: a test push to ${onCall ? "the phone on call" : "every staff phone"} is owed; the watcher publishes it at its next round, within a minute. If it does not ring, look at the console's home screen and tell the operator.`],
    };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- access-request

/**
 * Drafts the moderation part of an answer to a GDPR access request and records that it did, on the API role: for a
 * handle the account's cases and its own reports, for an address the notices of the contacts the auth module found for
 * it (`contactsOf`, which alone can read a contact). The audit row carries counts only, and names the account for a
 * handle and nobody for an address.
 */
export async function accessRequest(
  apiDb: Runner,
  appOrigin: string,
  who: { handle: string } | { email: string },
  contactsOf: (email: string) => Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]>,
  // 3f (W.8): for a handle, which of its cases an authority asked to keep from the person, read as the migrator.
  authorityHolds?: (caseIds: readonly string[]) => Promise<Map<string, string | null>>,
): Promise<{ ok: true; draft: AccountAccessDraft | ContactsAccessDraft } | { ok: false; problem: string }> {
  if ("handle" in who) {
    const handle = handleArg(who.handle);
    const [profile] = await apiDb.select({ id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    const draft = await accessDraftForAccount(apiDb, appOrigin, profile, authorityHolds);
    await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: "user", targetId: profile.id, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: draft.cases.length, contacts: 0 } }));
    return { ok: true, draft };
  }
  const contacts = await contactsOf(who.email);
  const draft = await accessDraftForContacts(apiDb, appOrigin, contacts);
  await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: 0, contacts: contacts.length } }));
  return { ok: true, draft };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- text-verify

/** One thing text-verify found wrong, and what it is about: an audit row by its place, or a decision, a post, an image or a seal by its id. */
export interface TextProblem {
  about: "audit" | "decision" | "post" | "image" | "seal" | "order" | "gap";
  id: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface TextReport {
  ok: boolean;
  /** The confirmed rows read, and the decisions, posts, images and seals in force checked. */
  auditRows: number;
  decisions: number;
  posts: number;
  images: number;
  seals: number;
  /** The first problems, in the order found. */
  problems: TextProblem[];
  problemCount: number;
}

/** How many rows text-verify reads at a time. */
export const TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const PAGE = TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE;

/** The actions whose params name saved texts and snapshots by their digests. */
const CONFIRMED_ACTIONS = ["case_decided", "appeals_reviewed", "identity_revealed", "order_effected"];
/** The params members that name a saved text. */
const TEXT_MEMBERS = ["factsDigest", "reasonDigest", "legalReferenceDigest"];

interface NamingRow {
  place: number;
  action: string;
  actorId: string;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  params: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** 3f: for an order_effected row, the order's item under which its decisionIds name the decision. */
  itemId?: string;
}

const isObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
/** An action as the key signed it and as the ledger holds it: its kind, its image, and (3e) the days and whether it was announced. */
const actionKey = (action: { kind: unknown; mediaId: unknown; days?: unknown; announced?: unknown }) =>
  [action.kind, action.mediaId, action.days, action.announced].map((part) => (part === null || part === undefined ? "" : String(part))).join(":");

/**
 * text-verify (3c design, section 7.13), read-only on the API's role. audit-verify proves that the record was not
 * rewritten; this proves that what the record's confirmed rows name is still what korbat holds, and that what posts and
 * images show is what the record says. Three checks, each in this command's own code:
 *
 *   1. Every digest in the params of a confirmed row (a decision, a review, a reveal) names a saved text that korbat
 *      still holds and that recomputes to it, an erased text, a snapshot still held that recomputes to it, or an erased
 *      snapshot. A text or a snapshot that is missing was removed around the erasures, which keep each row and its digest.
 *   2. Every decision is named by exactly one such row, written by the deciding account on the decision's case (for a
 *      review, on the reviewed decision), whose params equal the decision's own columns and whose actions equal its
 *      ledger rows as a set (3e: with each row's days and whether it was announced; the marks the decision set equal the
 *      params' `unfounded`, and a withdrawal for another measure its `replaced`). A signed mark that korbat's own rules
 *      deleted is no difference: its report was sent on a UTC day before the frame of the reporting counts (the
 *      retention job's step), or korbat no longer knows who sent the report (the sender's account was purged, which
 *      deletes its marks; an intake whose record was erased also forgets its sender, so a mark deleted by hand from such
 *      a report is not told apart). A row that names a decision korbat does not hold is reported too.
 *   3. Every post's level and every image's state equal what the ledger of measures gives, worked out here from the
 *      ledger's rows, the cases' closures, the items and the erasure marks, as the database's own writer derives them;
 *      and every post a seal in force lists still has the number of image rows the seal recorded.
 *
 * So a change made around the triggers, by the migrator or by hand, is reported: a decision or a measure altered or
 * removed, a level or a state set, a sealed image row destroyed or lost in a restore. `keep` bounds the problems kept.
 */
export async function textVerify(q: Runner, keep = 100): Promise<TextReport> {
  const problems: TextProblem[] = [];
  let problemCount = 0;
  const problem = (about: TextProblem["about"], id: string, message: string) => {
    problemCount++;
    if (problems.length < keep) problems.push({ about, id, message });
  };

  // ---- 1. the confirmed rows and what their digests name
  const naming = new Map<string, NamingRow[]>();
  let auditRows = 0;
  for (let after = 0; ; ) {
    const page = await rowsOf<{ id: number; place: number; action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: unknown }>(
      q,
      sql`select id::int as id, chain_seq::int as place, action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata from audit_log
           where action = any(${textArray(CONFIRMED_ACTIONS)}) and id > ${after} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    const wanted: { place: number; member: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    const wantedSnapshots: { place: number; id: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    for (const row of page) {
      auditRows++;
      const metadata = isObject(row.metadata) ? row.metadata : {};
      const params = isObject(metadata.params) ? metadata.params : null;
      if (params === null) {
        problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, carries no params`);
        continue;
      }
      for (const member of TEXT_MEMBERS) if (typeof params[member] === "string") wanted.push({ place: row.place, member, digest: params[member] });
      if (typeof params.snapshotId === "string" && typeof params.snapshotDigest === "string") wantedSnapshots.push({ place: row.place, id: params.snapshotId, digest: params.snapshotDigest });
      if (row.action === "order_effected") {
        // 3f: one row names up to ten order decisions, each under its item (metadata.decisionIds).
        const named = isObject(metadata.decisionIds) ? Object.entries(metadata.decisionIds) : [];
        if (named.length === 0) problem("audit", String(row.place), "its action, order_effected, names no decision");
        for (const [itemId, decisionId] of named) {
          if (typeof decisionId !== "string") continue;
          naming.set(decisionId, [...(naming.get(decisionId) ?? []), { place: row.place, action: row.action, actorId: row.actor_id, targetType: row.target_type, targetId: row.target_id, params, itemId }]);
        }
      } else if (row.action !== "identity_revealed") {
        const decisionId = typeof metadata.decisionId === "string" ? metadata.decisionId : null;
        if (decisionId === null) problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, names no decision`);
        else naming.set(decisionId, [...(naming.get(decisionId) ?? []), { place: row.place, action: row.action, actorId: row.actor_id, targetType: row.target_type, targetId: row.target_id, params }]);
      }
    }
    if (wanted.length > 0) {
      const texts = await rowsOf<{ digest: string; text: string | null; salt: string | null }>(q, sql`select digest, text, salt from staff_texts where digest = any(${textArray([...new Set(wanted.map((w) => w.digest))])})`);
      const byDigest = new Map(texts.map((t) => [t.digest, t]));
      for (const w of wanted) {
        const held = byDigest.get(w.digest);
        if (!held) problem("audit", String(w.place), `its ${w.member} names no saved text`);
        // An erased text keeps its row and its digest: that is retention at work, and nothing to report.
        else if (held.text !== null && (held.salt === null || (await textDigest(held.salt, held.text).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest)) problem("audit", String(w.place), `the text its ${w.member} names no longer recomputes to that digest`);
      }
    }
    if (wantedSnapshots.length > 0) {
      const found = await rowsOf<Record<string, unknown> & { id: string; digest: string; erased: boolean }>(
        q,
        sql`select id, digest, erased_at is not null as erased, salt, target_type::text as target_type, target_id,
                   to_char(taken_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as taken_at, author_handle, post_state::text as post_state,
                   to_char(post_created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as post_created_at, reply_to_id, quote_of_id, body, media, display_name, bio, handle
              from evidence_snapshots where id = any(${uuidArray([...new Set(wantedSnapshots.map((w) => w.id))])})`,
      );
      const byId = new Map(found.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      for (const w of wantedSnapshots) {
        const s = byId.get(w.id);
        if (!s) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotId names no snapshot");
        else if (s.digest !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotDigest is not the digest of the snapshot it names");
        else if (!s.erased) {
          const input = { salt: s.salt, targetType: s.target_type, targetId: s.target_id, takenAt: s.taken_at, authorHandle: s.author_handle, postState: s.post_state, postCreatedAt: s.post_created_at, replyToId: s.reply_to_id, quoteOfId: s.quote_of_id, body: s.body, media: s.media, displayName: s.display_name, bio: s.bio, handle: s.handle } as unknown as SnapshotDigestInput;
          if ((await snapshotDigest(input).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest");
        }
      }
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  // ---- 2. every decision against the one row that names it
  let decisions = 0;
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; d: Record<string, unknown>; actions: { kind: string; mediaId: string | null; days: number | null; announced: boolean | null }[]; marks: string[]; forgotten: string[]; replaced: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select d.id, to_jsonb(d) as d,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', a.kind, 'mediaId', a.media_id, 'days', a.days, 'announced', a.announced)) from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as actions,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(m.item_id) from unfounded_marks m where m.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as marks,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(i.id) from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id
                            where i.answered_by = d.id
                              and ((n.received_at at time zone 'UTC')::date <= (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - (select k.report_frame_days from standing_rules() k)
                                   or n.reporter_id is null)), '[]'::jsonb) as forgotten,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.replaced) as replaced
            from decisions d where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`d.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by d.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const { id, d, actions, marks, forgotten, replaced } of page) {
      decisions++;
      seen.add(id);
      const named = naming.get(id) ?? [];
      if (named.length !== 1) {
        problem("decision", id, named.length === 0 ? "no confirmed row of the audit log names it" : `${named.length} rows of the audit log name it (places ${named.map((row) => row.place).join(", ")})`);
        continue;
      }
      const row = named[0]!;
      if (d.kind === "order") {
        // 3f (section 8.11): an order decision against its order_effected row: the deciding account, its order, its item,
        // the order's facts as signed (unless an order_corrected row since changed them), and one disable_by_order.
        const [order] = await rowsOf<Record<string, unknown> & { corrected: boolean }>(
          q,
          sql`select o.id, o.kind, o.member_state, o.authority, o.reference, o.section_c, o.emergency, o.withhold_from_author,
                     exists (select 1 from audit_log l where l.action = 'order_corrected' and l.target_id = o.id::text and l.chain_seq > ${row.place}) as corrected
                from legal_order_items i join legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where i.id = ${String(d.order_item_id)}::uuid`,
        );
        const differing: string[] = [];
        if (row.action !== "order_effected") differing.push("action");
        if (row.actorId !== d.decided_by) differing.push("actor");
        if (order === undefined || row.targetType !== "order" || row.targetId !== order.id || row.itemId !== d.order_item_id) differing.push("target");
        if (order !== undefined && !order.corrected) {
          const facts = { kind: order.kind, memberState: order.member_state, authority: order.authority, reference: order.reference, sectionC: order.section_c, emergency: order.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: order.withhold_from_author };
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(facts)) if ((row.params[key] ?? null) !== value) differing.push(key);
        }
        if (actions.length !== 1 || actions[0]!.kind !== "disable_by_order") differing.push("actions");
        if (differing.length > 0) problem("decision", id, `it differs from the audit row at place ${row.place} that names it: ${[...new Set(differing)].sort().join(", ")}`);
        continue;
      }
      const review = d.kind === "review";
      const expected: Record<string, unknown> = review
        ? { stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, appealId: d.appeal_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest }
        : {
            kind: d.kind, stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, throughSeq: d.through_seq, reviewsDecisionId: d.reviews_decision_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome,
            ground: d.ground, ruleId: d.rule_id, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, categoryKeyword: d.category_keyword,
            factsDigest: d.facts_digest, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest, legalReferenceDigest: d.legal_reference_digest,
          };
      const differing: string[] = [];
      if (row.actorId !== d.decided_by) differing.push("actor");
      if (row.action !== (review ? "appeals_reviewed" : "case_decided") || row.targetType !== (review ? "decision" : "case") || row.targetId !== (review ? d.reviews_decision_id : d.case_id)) differing.push("target");
      for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(expected), ...Object.keys(row.params)])) {
        if (key === "actions" || key === "unfounded" || key === "replaced") continue;
        if ((expected[key] ?? null) !== (row.params[key] ?? null)) differing.push(key);
        if (!(key in expected)) differing.push(key);
      }
      // 3e: the marks the decision set, as the sorted item ids its params signed, and whether it withdrew a suspension for
      // another measure; a review signs neither, and a row signed before 3e lacks both, which reads as none and false.
      if (!review) {
        const signed = row.params.unfounded === undefined ? [] : Array.isArray(row.params.unfounded) ? row.params.unfounded.map(String) : null;
        // 3e Task 7: a signed mark with no row is no difference when korbat's own rules may have deleted it (above).
        const held = new Set(marks);
        const expected = signed?.filter((item) => held.has(item) || !forgotten.includes(item));
        if (expected === undefined || [...expected].sort().join("|") !== [...marks].sort().join("|")) differing.push("unfounded");
        if ((row.params.replaced ?? false) !== replaced) differing.push("replaced");
      }
      const recorded = Array.isArray(row.params.actions) ? row.params.actions.filter(isObject).map((a) => actionKey({ kind: a.kind, mediaId: a.mediaId, days: a.days, announced: a.announced })) : null;
      if (recorded === null || [...recorded].sort().join("|") !== actions.map(actionKey).sort().join("|")) differing.push("actions");
      if (differing.length > 0) problem("decision", id, `it differs from the audit row at place ${row.place} that names it: ${[...new Set(differing)].sort().join(", ")}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const [decisionId, named] of naming) if (!seen.has(decisionId)) problem("decision", decisionId, `the audit row at place ${named[0]!.place} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`);

  // ---- 3. levels and states, worked out from the ledger
  const measures = MEASURE_KINDS as readonly string[];
  const removedPosts = new Set<string>();
  const withheldPosts = new Set<string>();
  // 3f: a disable_by_order in force that keeps the post from its author too; one that does not counts as a removal.
  const disabledPosts = new Set<string>();
  const removedImages = new Set<string>();
  const withheldImages = new Set<string>();
  const sealsInForce = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; kind: string; post_id: string | null; media_id: string | null; decision_kind: string; case_open: boolean; suspect_open: boolean; reversed: boolean; withhold_author: boolean | null }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select a.id, a.kind::text as kind, a.post_id, a.media_id, d.kind::text as decision_kind, c.closed_at is null as case_open, a.withhold_author,
                 exists (select 1 from intake_items i where i.case_id = d.case_id and i.suspect and i.answered_by is null and i.created_at <= d.decided_at) as suspect_open,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) as reversed
            from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
           where a.kind::text = any(${textArray(measures)}) and ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`a.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by a.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const m of page) {
      // In force: no row reverses it, and a measure taken while deciding lasts while its case is open, a seal taken while
      // deciding while its case holds an unanswered suspect item that arrived no later than it.
      const inForce = !m.reversed && (m.decision_kind !== "interim" || (m.kind === "seal_media" ? m.suspect_open : m.case_open));
      if (!inForce) continue;
      if (m.kind === "remove" && m.post_id) removedPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "disable_by_order" && m.post_id) (m.withhold_author ? disabledPosts : removedPosts).add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold" && m.post_id) withheldPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "remove_media" && m.media_id) removedImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold_media" && m.media_id) withheldImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "seal_media") sealsInForce.add(m.id);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  // The posts each seal in force lists, with the image rows it recorded for each.
  const listed: { actionId: string; postId: string; images: number }[] = [];
  const sealedPosts = new Set<string>();
  if (sealsInForce.size > 0) {
    const found = await rowsOf<{ action_id: string; post_id: string; images: number }>(q, sql`select action_id, post_id, images::int as images from seal_posts where action_id = any(${uuidArray([...sealsInForce])}) order by action_id, post_id`);
    for (const row of found) {
      listed.push({ actionId: row.action_id, postId: row.post_id, images: row.images });
      sealedPosts.add(row.post_id);
    }
  }

  let posts = 0;
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; state: string; level: string; erased: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select id, state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level, erased_at is not null as erased from posts where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`id > ${after}::uuid`} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const post of page) {
      posts++;
      const level =
        !post.erased && disabledPosts.has(post.id) ? "disabled" : post.erased || removedPosts.has(post.id) || disabledPosts.has(post.id) ? "removed" : withheldPosts.has(post.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (post.level !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its level is stored as ${post.level}, and the ledger of measures gives ${level}`);
      // The state mirrors the level unless the author deleted the post, which is terminal.
      else if (post.state !== "deleted_by_author" && post.state !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its state is stored as ${post.state}, and its level is ${level}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  let images = 0;
  const imagesOn = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page = await imageModerationStates(q as Db, after, PAGE);
    for (const image of page) {
      images++;
      if (sealedPosts.has(image.postId)) imagesOn.set(image.postId, (imagesOn.get(image.postId) ?? 0) + 1);
      const state = sealedPosts.has(image.postId) ? "sealed" : image.erasedAt !== null || removedImages.has(image.id) ? "removed" : withheldImages.has(image.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (image.moderationState !== state) problem("image", image.id, `its state is stored as ${image.moderationState}, and the ledger of measures gives ${state}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const row of listed) {
    const now = imagesOn.get(row.postId) ?? 0;
    if (now !== row.images) problem("seal", row.actionId, `it lists post ${row.postId} with ${row.images} image ${row.images === 1 ? "row" : "rows"}, and the post has ${now} now`);
  }

  // ---- 4. 3f (section 8.11): an order's item and its measure name each other; every console event has its audit row.
  for (const row of await rowsOf<{ id: string; order_id: string; message: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select i.id, i.order_id, 'it is recorded as disabled, and no measure of an order decision names it' as message
          from legal_order_items i where i.disabled_at is not null
           and not exists (select 1 from decisions d join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id where d.order_item_id = i.id and a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order')
           -- 3f Task 6: an item whose disabling a restore lost holds its first disabling's time from the import, and no
           -- measure until a person takes it again (or an admin finds it not needed); its gap is the record of that.
           and not exists (select 1 from restore_gaps g where g.class = 'order_effect' and g.target_type = 'order_item' and g.target_id = i.id::text)
        union all
        select i.id, i.order_id, 'a measure in force names it, and the item names another measure' as message
          from legal_order_items i join decisions d on d.order_item_id = i.id join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order'
         where exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.id = a.id) and i.action_id is distinct from a.id`,
  )) {
    problem("order", row.order_id, `item ${row.id}: ${row.message}`);
  }
  for (const row of await rowsOf<{ id: string; order_id: string; kind: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select e.id, e.order_id, e.kind from legal_order_events e
         where e.via = 'console' and e.kind not in ('opened', 'effect_given', 'reinstated')
           and not exists (select 1 from audit_log l where l.action in ('order_event_recorded', 'order_corrected') and l.target_id = e.order_id::text and l.metadata ->> 'eventId' = e.id::text)`,
  )) {
    problem("order", row.order_id, `its ${row.kind} event ${row.id} has no audit row`);
  }
  // ---- 5. 3f Task 6 (sections 6.6 and 8.11): every gap closed as not needed has its confirmed audit row gap_closed.
  for (const row of await rowsOf<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select g.id from restore_gaps g
         where g.disposition = 'not_needed'
           and not exists (select 1 from audit_log l where l.action = 'gap_closed' and l.target_type = 'restore_gap' and l.target_id = g.id::text and l.step_up is not null)`,
  )) {
    problem("gap", row.id, "it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it");
  }

  return { ok: problemCount === 0, auditRows, decisions, posts, images, seals: sealsInForce.size, problems, problemCount };
}

/** text-verify on the command line's own connection: one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction, so every check reads one state of the database. */
export function textVerifyOn(apiDb: Db): Promise<TextReport> {
  return apiDb.transaction(
    async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      return textVerify(tx);
    },
    { isolationLevel: "repeatable read", accessMode: "read only" },
  );
}

/** How text-verify reports: what holds, or the first problems. */
export function describeTextReport(report: TextReport): string[] {
  const counted = `${report.auditRows} confirmed rows, ${report.decisions} decisions, ${report.posts} posts, ${report.images} images and ${report.seals} seals in force`;
  if (report.ok) return [`text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: ${counted}`];
  const shown = report.problems.slice(0, 20);
  const lines = [`text-verify: FAILED, ${report.problemCount} ${report.problemCount === 1 ? "problem" : "problems"} in ${counted}; the first:`];
  for (const p of shown) lines.push(`  ${p.about === "audit" ? "place" : p.about} ${p.id}: ${p.message}`);
  if (report.problemCount > shown.length) lines.push(`  and ${report.problemCount - shown.length} more`);
  return lines;
}
```

```ts
 * The commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13) do their work in staff-cases.ts. link and unlink record a

 * the migrate service; 3f's notification-facts (cli/records.ts) replaces account-facts. text-verify holds what the record

import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, createAuthRepo, notifierContactsFor, revokeStaffKeys, verifyRecordedAssertion, type StaffKeysRevokedReport } from "../auth";

/** A place in the chain and the hash it had when someone kept it, as audit-head printed it. */

}

export type StaffCommand =
  | { command: "enroll"; email: string }
```
