```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ActionKind, OrderNoticeFacts, OrderTexts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { iso, rows, type Runner, type TargetType } from "./repo";

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). The expression is written here, never input. */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * The queries a statement of reasons is read from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10): the decision with its texts and the
 * decision it is about, its ledger rows, and the measures taken while deciding that ended with it. Every surface an
 * author reads a statement on (the decision's screen, the mail, the export, the answer to an appeal) is rendered from
 * these, so they are kept apart from the module's other queries: a test refuses the names of the tables of reports and
 * notices in this file, but for one pinned read in endedMeasures, which answers true or false of the case's own items.
 */

/** A decision as its statement is rendered from it, with what the mail and the staff alerts need beside it. */
export interface StatementDecisionRow {
  id: string;
  caseId: string;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "order" | "review" | "correction";
  outcome: string;
  ground: string | null;
  ruleId: string | null;
  rulesVersion: number;
  redressVersion: number;
  source: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  suspect: boolean;
  authorMail: string;
  /** 3f: when the statement's first mail was recorded; an order's notice mailed again after the authority's words is a mail of its own. */
  authorMailAt: string | null;
  decidedBy: string;
  facts: string | null;
  reason: string | null;
  legalReference: string | null;
  targetType: TargetType;
  targetId: string;
  /** The post's creation time, which survives its deletion; null for an account case. */
  postCreatedAt: string | null;
  /** The account the decision is about: the post's author, or the account itself. */
  subjectId: string | null;
  /** The decision a review or a correction is about; (3e's review) with the basis of its suspension or termination, null for none. */
  reviewed: { kind: "interim" | "final" | "order"; ground: string | null; ruleId: string | null; rulesVersion: number; legalReference: string | null; decidedAt: string; basis: string | null } | null;
}

export async function statementDecision(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementDecisionRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.case_id, d.kind, d.outcome, d.ground, d.rule_id, d.rules_version, d.redress_version, d.source, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, d.suspect, d.author_mail, ${iso("d.author_mail_at")} as author_mail_at, d.decided_by,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal_reference,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               case when c.target_type = 'post' then (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) else c.target_id end as subject_id,
               r.kind as reviewed_kind, r.ground as reviewed_ground, r.rule_id as reviewed_rule, r.rules_version as reviewed_rules_version, ${iso("r.decided_at")} as reviewed_at,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = r.legal_reference_digest) as reviewed_legal,
               (select a.basis::text from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = r.id and a.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')) as reviewed_basis
          from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id left join decisions r on r.id = d.reviews_decision_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    caseId: row.case_id as string,
    kind: row.kind as StatementDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    ground: row.ground as string | null,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    rulesVersion: row.rules_version as number,
    redressVersion: row.redress_version as number,
    source: row.source as string,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at as string,
    suspect: row.suspect as boolean,
    authorMail: row.author_mail as string,
    authorMailAt: row.author_mail_at as string | null,
    decidedBy: row.decided_by as string,
    facts: row.facts as string | null,
    reason: row.reason as string | null,
    legalReference: row.legal_reference as string | null,
    targetType: row.target_type as TargetType,
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    postCreatedAt: row.post_created_at as string | null,
    subjectId: row.subject_id as string | null,
    reviewed:
      row.reviewed_kind === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: row.reviewed_kind as "interim" | "final" | "order",
            ground: row.reviewed_ground as string | null,
            ruleId: row.reviewed_rule as string | null,
            rulesVersion: row.reviewed_rules_version as number,
            legalReference: row.reviewed_legal as string | null,
            decidedAt: row.reviewed_at as string,
            basis: row.reviewed_basis as string | null,
          },
  };
}

/** One ledger row of a decision as its statement tells of it: for a reversal the measure it lifts, for a seal what its list held. */
export interface StatementActionRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null;
  /** For a reversal: the decision that holds the lifted measure, its rule, whether that measure changed anything, and whether korbat still kept that decision's snapshot when this one was made. */
  lifted: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean } | null;
  sealedPosts: number;
  sealedImages: number;
  /** The seal's images on posts their author had deleted by the time it was recorded: nothing later is read. */
  sealedDeletedImages: number;
  /** A strike's end of counting, and the strikes of its account that stood and counted at its decision's time, this one included. */
  endsAt: string | null;
  activeThen: number | null;
  /** On a suspension or a termination: whether it was announced; null on every other kind. */
  announced: boolean | null;
  /**
   * On a retirement, the handle of its decision's snapshot in lower case, as the database retires it; on a reversal of one,
   * the same of the lifted decision. A snapshot keeps its handle through an erasure (3e design, section 6.7). Null otherwise.
   */
  handle: string | null;
  /** On a retirement that changed the profile, the placeholder it gave, made from the measure's id as the database makes it. */
  placeholder: string | null;
  /**
   * 3e (design, section 10.2), on a standing measure: its days, its basis, its earliest start (the row's starts_at), and
   * one entry for each decision it rests on (its time, its rule and the time of its post; for a protective suspension
   * the sealing decision's time alone). A measure taken at once also ends: `endsAt` is its created_at plus its days.
   */
  days: number | null;
  basis: string | null;
  earliestStart: string | null;
  restsOn: { decidedAt: string; ruleId: string | null; postCreatedAt: string | null }[] | null;
  /**
   * 3e, on the lift of a suspension or a termination: the lifted measure's kind and decision's time, where its period
   * stood at this decision's time (by suspension_periods, whose end a lift cuts to the lift's time), and whether the lift
   * was signed `replaced`.
   */
  liftedKind: "suspend" | "terminate" | "warn_reporting" | "restrict_reporting" | null;
  liftedDecidedAt: string | null;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null } | null;
  replaced: boolean | null;
  /** 3e Task 4, on such a lift: when the person had replied to the lifted measure, or null when they had not. */
  replyFiledAt: string | null;
  /** 3e Task 5, on a restriction of reporting: the time of the warning it follows (its decision's). */
  warnedAt: string | null;
}

/** A decision's measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds. */
export async function statementActions(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementActionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect, l.decision_id as lifted_decision, ld.rule_id as lifted_rule, l.no_effect as lifted_no_effect,
               (ls.erased_at is null or ls.erased_at > d.decided_at) as lifted_snapshot_kept,
               (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_posts,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_images,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s join posts p on p.id = s.post_id
                 where s.action_id = a.id and p.state = 'deleted_by_author' and p.deleted_at <= a.created_at) as sealed_deleted,
               case when a.kind in ('strike', 'warn_reporting') then ${iso("a.ends_at")}
                    when a.kind = 'suspend' and a.announced is false then ${iso("(a.created_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")}
                    when a.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then ${iso("(a.starts_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")} end as ends_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') then a.days end as days,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting') then a.basis end as basis,
               -- 3e Task 5: the warning a restriction of reporting follows, by its decision's time (the one entry of rests_on).
               case when a.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x where x.id = a.rests_on[1]) end as warned_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               -- The decisions a standing measure rests on, in the ledger's order: what korbat fixed for good about each.
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.rests_on is not null then (
                 select json_agg(json_build_object('decidedAt', ${iso("x.decided_at")},
                                                   'ruleId', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else x.rule_id end,
                                                   'postCreatedAt', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else ${iso("xp.created_at")} end) order by u.ord)
                   from unnest(a.rests_on) with ordinality as u(id, ord)
                   join decisions x on x.id = u.id
                   join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id
                   left join posts xp on xc.target_type = 'post' and xp.id = xc.target_id) end as rests_on,
               case when a.kind in ('lift_suspension', 'lift_reporting') then l.kind::text end as lifted_kind,
               case when a.kind in ('lift_suspension', 'lift_reporting') then ${iso("ld.decided_at")} end as lifted_decided_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then a.replaced end as replaced,
               -- Whether the person had replied to the lifted measure before this lift: a withdrawal then says it is no answer to it.
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = l.id and r.filed_at <= a.created_at) end as reply_filed_at,
               -- Where the lifted measure's period stood at this lift's time: the lift cuts its end to that time, so a period
               -- that ends before it had already ended, and one with no start, or a start not before it, never started.
               ${iso("lp.starts_at")} as lifted_started_at, ${finite("lp.ends_at")} as lifted_ended_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_reporting' and l.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                      then case when l.starts_at + make_interval(days => l.days) <= a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end
                    when a.kind <> 'lift_suspension' then null
                    when lp.starts_at is null or lp.starts_at >= a.created_at then 'not_started'
                    when lp.ends_at < a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as lifted_state,
               -- 3e Task 5: a lifted restriction of reporting started with its decision and ran its days, unless lifted first.
               ${iso("l.starts_at")} as lifted_restriction_started_at, ${iso("(l.starts_at + make_interval(days => l.days))")} as lifted_restriction_ends_at,
               -- What the ledger held at the decision's time, never later: a strike that counted then, and was not overruled by then.
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then (select count(*)::int from decision_actions s
                     where s.subject_account_id = a.subject_account_id and s.kind = 'strike' and s.created_at <= a.created_at and s.ends_at > a.created_at
                       and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = s.id and r.created_at <= a.created_at)) end as active_then,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then a.announced end as announced,
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' then (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.id = d.snapshot_id)
                    when a.kind = 'unretire_handle' then lower(ls.handle) end as handle,
               -- The placeholder exactly as decision_actions_apply computes it, for a retirement that wrote it.
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' and a.no_effect is null
                    then 'retired_' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12) end as placeholder
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join decision_actions l on l.id = a.reverses_action_id
          left join decisions ld on ld.id = l.decision_id
          left join evidence_snapshots ls on ls.id = ld.snapshot_id
          left join suspension_periods lp on a.kind = 'lift_suspension' and lp.action_id = l.id
         where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind as ActionKind,
    mediaId: row.media_id as string | null,
    noEffect: row.no_effect as StatementActionRow["noEffect"],
    lifted: row.lifted_decision === null ? null : { decisionId: row.lifted_decision as string, ruleId: row.lifted_rule as string | null, noEffect: row.lifted_no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.lifted_snapshot_kept as boolean },
    sealedPosts: row.sealed_posts as number,
    sealedImages: row.sealed_images as number,
    sealedDeletedImages: row.sealed_deleted as number,
    endsAt: row.ends_at as string | null,
    activeThen: row.active_then as number | null,
    announced: row.announced as boolean | null,
    handle: row.handle as string | null,
    placeholder: row.placeholder as string | null,
    days: row.days as number | null,
    basis: row.basis as string | null,
    earliestStart: row.earliest_start as string | null,
    restsOn: row.rests_on as StatementActionRow["restsOn"],
    liftedKind: row.lifted_kind as StatementActionRow["liftedKind"],
    liftedDecidedAt: row.lifted_decided_at as string | null,
    periodThen:
      row.lifted_state === null
        ? null
        : row.kind === "lift_reporting"
          ? {
              // A restriction of reporting starts with its decision: it ran, or had run its days, when it was lifted.
              state: row.lifted_state as "running" | "ended",
              startedAt: row.lifted_restriction_started_at as string | null,
              endedAt: row.lifted_state === "ended" ? (row.lifted_restriction_ends_at as string | null) : null,
            }
          : {
              state: row.lifted_state as "not_started" | "running" | "ended",
              startedAt: row.lifted_state === "not_started" ? null : (row.lifted_started_at as string | null),
              endedAt: row.lifted_state === "ended" ? (row.lifted_ended_at as string | null) : null,
            },
    replaced: row.replaced as boolean | null,
    replyFiledAt: row.reply_filed_at as string | null,
    warnedAt: row.warned_at as string | null,
  }));
}

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with a final decision, without a reversal. */
export interface EndedMeasureRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  decisionId: string;
  ruleId: string | null;
  noEffect: string | null;
  snapshotKept: boolean;
}

/**
 * The measures taken while deciding that ended with this final decision, of those their author was told of: every one
 * that was still in force when the decision closed its case, and a seal taken while deciding whose suspect items the
 * decision answered, unless the decision itself seals (the images then stay sealed). It reads only what stood when the
 * decision was made: a reversal recorded later, or an item that arrived later, changes nothing here.
 */
export async function endedMeasures(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedMeasureRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, i.id as decision_id, i.rule_id, a.no_effect, (s.erased_at is null or s.erased_at > d.decided_at) as snapshot_kept
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join decisions i on i.case_id = d.case_id and i.kind = 'interim' and i.decided_at < d.decided_at and i.author_mail <> 'none'
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = i.id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = i.snapshot_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind = 'final'
           and a.kind in ('withhold', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id and r.created_at <= d.decided_at)
           and case when a.kind = 'seal_media'
                 then exists (select 1 from intake_items x where x.case_id = d.case_id and x.suspect and x.answered_by = d.id and x.created_at <= i.decided_at)
                      and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions own where own.decision_id = d.id and own.kind = 'seal_media')
                 else c.closed_at = d.decided_at end
         order by i.decided_at, a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind as ActionKind, mediaId: row.media_id as string | null, decisionId: row.decision_id as string, ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null, noEffect: row.no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.snapshot_kept as boolean }));
}

/** A standing measure, or a restriction of reporting, whose basis a reversal of a decision broke (3e design, sections 6.2 and 10.2). */
export interface EndedStandingRow {
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate" | "restrict_reporting";
  decidedAt: string;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  seal: boolean;
  replyFiledAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * The suspensions and terminations whose basis this review or correction broke: those that name the reviewed decision in
 * rests_on and whose basis broke at this decision's time (standing_basis_broken_at answers the time of the reversal that
 * broke it, which is this decision's own). For each, where its period stood at this decision's time (the break cut its
 * end to that time), whether the basis was a seal, and the time of its reply when this decision answered it. Task 5:
 * the restrictions of reporting whose warning this decision lifted, unless a lift of their own came first; a restriction
 * starts with its decision, so it was running, or had run its days (ended), at this decision's time.
 */
export async function endedStanding(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedStandingRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ kind: EndedStandingRow["kind"]; decided_at: string; state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; started_at: string | null; ended_at: string | null; seal: boolean; reply_filed_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select m.kind::text as kind, ${iso("md.decided_at")} as decided_at, t.state,
               ${iso("t.started_at")} as started_at, ${finite("t.ended_at")} as ended_at,
               m.basis = 'protective' as seal,
               (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id) as reply_filed_at
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') and d.reviews_decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
          join decisions md on md.id = m.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
          cross join lateral (
            select case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                        then case when m.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days) <= d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end
                        when p.starts_at is null or p.starts_at >= d.decided_at then 'not_started'
                        when p.ends_at < d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as state,
                   case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then m.starts_at else p.starts_at end as started_at,
                   case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then m.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days) else p.ends_at end as ended_at
          ) t
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) = d.decided_at
           and (m.kind <> 'restrict_reporting' or not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id and x.created_at < d.decided_at))
         order by md.decided_at, m.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at,
    periodThen: { state: row.state, startedAt: row.state === "not_started" ? null : row.started_at, endedAt: row.state === "ended" ? row.ended_at : null },
    seal: row.seal,
    replyFiledAt: row.reply_filed_at,
  }));
}

/** The reply a correction or a review answered by keeping or reversing its measure (3e design, section 10.2). */
export interface RepliedToRow {
  filedAt: string;
  onTime: boolean;
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
  days: number | null;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  startsAt: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  appealUntil: string;
}

/**
 * The reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing the measure of the decision it is about: a reply
 * to a suspension or a termination of that decision whose answering decision is this one. Never a withdrawal signed
 * `replaced` (it is no answer on the reply's merits), and never the end of a broken basis (that measure is not the
 * reviewed decision's: its reply is the reversal's endedStanding). Null when there is none.
 *
 * Each member is what the ledger fixed by this answer's time, so the statement reads as it was sent. The start: after a
 * kept answer to a reply before the start, the later of the answer and the earliest start, which nothing later moves; for
 * any other answer the period's own start, already fixed before the reply (a late reply) or never (a reversed one before
 * the start, which has no row). The end: a kept suspension's start plus its days; a reversed one's period end, which this
 * lift cut; null for a termination and for a measure that never starts. Where the period stood at this answer's time, by
 * those two. And the last moment of the announcing decision's appeal after this answer (appeal_informed_at).
 */
export async function repliedTo(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<RepliedToRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{
    filed_at: string;
    on_time: boolean;
    kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
    days: number | null;
    kept: boolean;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    started: boolean;
    ended: boolean;
    appeal_until: string;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select ${iso("r.filed_at")} as filed_at, r.on_time, m.kind::text as kind, m.days, t.kept,
               ${iso("t.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("t.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               coalesce(t.starts_at <= d.decided_at, false) as started, coalesce(t.ends_at <= d.decided_at, false) as ended,
               ${iso("public.appeal_deadline(public.appeal_informed_at(m.decision_id))")} as appeal_until
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id and m.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')
          join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
          cross join lateral (
            select x.kept,
                   case when x.kept and r.on_time then greatest(m.starts_at, r.answered_at) else p.starts_at end as starts_at,
                   case when m.kind::text = 'terminate' then null
                        when x.kept and r.on_time then greatest(m.starts_at, r.answered_at) + make_interval(days => m.days)
                        when x.kept then p.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days)
                        else p.ends_at end as ends_at
              from (select not exists (select 1 from decision_actions l where l.decision_id = d.id and l.reverses_action_id = m.id) as kept) x
          ) t
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions w where w.decision_id = d.id and w.kind = 'lift_suspension' and w.replaced)`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  const state: RepliedToRow["periodThen"]["state"] = !row.started ? "not_started" : row.ended ? "ended" : "running";
  return {
    filedAt: row.filed_at,
    onTime: row.on_time,
    kind: row.kind,
    days: row.kind === "terminate" ? null : row.days,
    periodThen: { state, startedAt: state === "not_started" ? null : row.starts_at, endedAt: state === "ended" ? row.ends_at : null },
    startsAt: row.starts_at,
    endsAt: row.ends_at,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until,
  };
}

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 7.10 and 10.4): what the notice of an order decision, or of the correction that reinstates after
 * one, is rendered from, read at every read from the order decision's row, its item's and its order's as they stand, so
 * the notice grows without a new decision; and the authority's words with the time from which the author holds them
 * (the newest texts_recorded event, or the decision's informed_at when that is later), and (3f's review) since when it
 * holds the reasons alone (the newest texts_recorded event of the reasons, the same way). Null for any other decision.
 * The home state is the API's setting, which the caller passes.
 */
export async function orderNoticeOf(
  q: Runner,
  decisionId: string,
  homeState: string | null,
): Promise<{ facts: OrderNoticeFacts; texts: OrderTexts; authorMailAt: string | null; erasedOn: string | null } | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select o.kind, o.member_state, o.authority, o.reference, o.verified_at is not null as verified,
               to_char(coalesce(o.issued_at, o.received_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as ordered_on,
               case when o.issued_at is not null then 'issued' when o.received_at is not null then 'received' end as ordered_from,
               o.cross_border, a.withhold_author, ${iso("od.decided_at")} as disabled_at,
               coalesce(od.informed_at > od.decided_at, false) as held, ${iso("od.informed_at")} as informed_at, o.hold_end_reason,
               ${iso("i.preserve_until")} as preserve_until,
               exists (select 1 from legal_order_events e where e.item_id = i.id and e.kind = 'preservation_extended') as preserve_extended,
               to_char(i.preserve_ended_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as preserve_ended_on,
               -- Task 4: the day the preservation's end erased the post, which sets the post's erased_at and the item's
               -- preserve_ended_at to the same instant; null for an end without an erasure.
               case when p.erased_at = i.preserve_ended_at then to_char(i.preserve_ended_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') end as erased_on,
               (select x.order_ground from decision_actions x where x.decision_id = d.id and x.kind::text = 'reinstate_by_order') as order_ground,
               o.reasons, o.redress, o.scope,
               ${iso("(select max(e.at) from legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'texts_recorded')")} as texts_recorded_at,
               -- 3f's review (people2): the newest record of the reasons alone. An event written before the review names no
               -- text and is not counted: the notice then counts from the telling, never from a later text.
               ${iso("(select max(e.at) from legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'texts_recorded' and e.ground = 'reasons')")} as reasons_recorded_at,
               ${iso("d.author_mail_at")} as author_mail_at
          from decisions d
          join decisions od on od.id = case when d.kind::text = 'order' then d.id else d.reviews_decision_id end and od.kind::text = 'order'
          join legal_order_items i on i.id = od.order_item_id
          join legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = od.id and a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order'
          left join posts p on p.id = i.post_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind::text in ('order', 'correction')`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  const informedAt = row.informed_at as string | null;
  const recordedAt = row.texts_recorded_at as string | null;
  const anyText = row.reasons !== null || row.redress !== null || row.scope !== null;
  // The author holds a text from the later of its record and the telling: a notice released after the record holds it from the release.
  const textsAt = !anyText || recordedAt === null ? null : informedAt !== null && Date.parse(informedAt) > Date.parse(recordedAt) ? informedAt : recordedAt;
  // The reasons from the later of their own record and the telling; from the telling when no event names them.
  const reasonsRecordedAt = row.reasons_recorded_at as string | null;
  const reasonsAt =
    row.reasons === null ? null : reasonsRecordedAt === null ? informedAt : informedAt !== null && Date.parse(informedAt) > Date.parse(reasonsRecordedAt) ? informedAt : reasonsRecordedAt;
  return {
    facts: {
      kind: row.kind as OrderNoticeFacts["kind"],
      memberState: row.member_state as OrderNoticeFacts["memberState"],
      authority: row.authority as string,
      reference: row.reference as string,
      verified: row.verified as boolean,
      orderedOn: row.ordered_on as string | null,
      orderedFrom: row.ordered_from as OrderNoticeFacts["orderedFrom"],
      crossBorder: row.cross_border as boolean,
      homeState: homeState as OrderNoticeFacts["homeState"],
      withholdAuthor: row.withhold_author as boolean,
      disabledAt: row.disabled_at as string,
      held: row.held as boolean,
      informedAt,
      holdEndReason: row.hold_end_reason as OrderNoticeFacts["holdEndReason"],
      preserveUntil: row.preserve_until as string | null,
      preserveExtended: row.preserve_extended as boolean,
      preserveEndedOn: row.preserve_ended_on as string | null,
      orderGround: row.order_ground as OrderNoticeFacts["orderGround"],
    },
    texts: { reasons: row.reasons as string | null, redress: row.redress as string | null, scope: row.scope as string | null, textsAt, reasonsAt },
    authorMailAt: row.author_mail_at as string | null,
    erasedOn: row.erased_on as string | null,
  };
}

/** The UTC day of the lost decision a decision took again, read from the gap it closed, which is kept as long as the decision (3f Task 6, sections 6.8 and 10.4). */
export async function reappliedOn(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ lost_on: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select to_char(g.acted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as lost_on from public.restore_gaps g
         where g.closed_by = ${decisionId}::uuid and g.disposition = 'reapplied' order by g.acted_at limit 1`,
  );
  return row?.lost_on ?? null;
}
```

```ts
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino, { type Logger } from "pino";
import { ALERT_RULES, PUSH_KINDS, type AlertKind, type AlertScope, type ContactFolder, type NotifyError } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { ImapFailure, checkImapValue, openImap, type ImapSession } from "./imap";
import { publish, type OwedPush } from "./push";

export type { OwedPush } from "./push";

/**
 * notify, the contact point's watcher (3f design, sections 5 and 7.1): an entry point of the API's image
 * (dist/notify.js) that runs one loop, alone, with its own database role, korbat_notify, and no lock. Every
 * ALERT_RULES.pollSeconds after the last round ended:
 *   1. it reads INBOX and the junk folder over IMAP (imap.ts), read-only, and inserts one row of contact_messages a new
 *      message, each in a transaction of its own with the folder's mark, so the first push never waits for the rest of a
 *      long folder; the database's triggers force the row's times and write the message's first push;
 *   2. it publishes every row of alert_outbox still owed its push (push.ts), oldest first, with no cap on attempts;
 *   3. it beats: notify_state says when it last ran, last read both folders and last published, and the word of its
 *      last failure, which the API's alert tick reads for the channel's health.
 * It reads no header, body or flag of any message, holds no SMTP credential, and imports the contracts and nothing of
 * the API's modules. It stops itself rather than hang: it exits 1 when the database has been unreachable for longer than
 * a round, or when no round has finished for WATCHDOG_MS, and Docker starts it again.
 */

/** No round finished for this long: the process exits, and Docker starts it again. */
export const WATCHDOG_MS = 2 * 60_000;
/** The file whose time the Compose health check reads: written after every round that reached the database. */
export const HEALTH_FILE = join(tmpdir(), "korbat-notify-beat");
/** The example's ntfy token (infra/ntfy/server.yml.example), which production refuses, as the API refuses test keys. */
export const EXAMPLE_PUBLISH_TOKENS: readonly string[] = ["tk_korbatdevpublisher00000000001"];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- settings

export interface NotifySettings {
  databaseUrl: string;
  production: boolean;
  imap: { host: string; port: number; user: string; password: string; junk: string; ca?: string; timeoutMs?: number };
  push: { url: string; token: string };
}

/**
 * The watcher's settings. No setting of a profiled service is required by Compose (it writes `${NAME:-}`), so the
 * program refuses to start on an empty one, naming it. NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT, NOTIFY_IMAP_CA and NOTIFY_PUSH_URL are for the
 * development mailbox alone, and production refuses them, as it refuses the example's ntfy token.
 */
export function readSettings(env: Record<string, string | undefined>, readFile: (path: string) => string = (path) => readFileSync(path, "utf8")): NotifySettings {
  const required = (name: string): string => {
    const value = env[name];
    if (value === undefined || value.trim() === "") throw new Error(`${name} is not set: notify cannot start without it (infra/.env, README Upgrading)`);
    return value;
  };
  const production = (env.NODE_ENV ?? "production").trim() !== "development" && (env.NODE_ENV ?? "").trim() !== "test";
  const devOnly = (name: string): string | undefined => {
    const value = env[name];
    if (value === undefined || value.trim() === "") return undefined;
    if (production) throw new Error(`${name} is for the development mailbox only and is refused in production`);
    return value.trim();
  };
  const settings: NotifySettings = {
    databaseUrl: required("DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY"),
    production,
    imap: { host: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST").trim(), port: 993, user: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_USER"), password: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD"), junk: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK") },
    push: { url: "http://ntfy:2586", token: required("NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN").trim() },
  };
  for (const name of ["NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST", "NOTIFY_IMAP_USER", "NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD", "NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK", "NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN"]) checkImapValue(name, env[name]!);
  // Compose builds the URL from KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD, which it does not require: an empty one is that setting missing.
  let databaseUrl: URL;
  try {
    databaseUrl = new URL(settings.databaseUrl);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY is not a PostgreSQL URL");
  }
  if (databaseUrl.password === "") throw new Error("KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD is not set: notify cannot sign in to the database without it (infra/.env, README Upgrading)");
  if (production && EXAMPLE_PUBLISH_TOKENS.includes(settings.push.token)) throw new Error("NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN is the example's token: production needs the publisher's own (README, On call)");
  const port = devOnly("NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT");
  if (port !== undefined) {
    if (!/^[0-9]{1,5}$/.test(port) || Number(port) < 1 || Number(port) > 65535) throw new Error("NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT must be a port number");
    settings.imap.port = Number(port);
  }
  const ca = devOnly("NOTIFY_IMAP_CA");
  if (ca !== undefined) settings.imap.ca = readFile(ca);
  const pushUrl = devOnly("NOTIFY_PUSH_URL");
  if (pushUrl !== undefined) {
    if (!/^https?:[/][/][^/]+$/.test(pushUrl)) throw new Error("NOTIFY_PUSH_URL must be an origin such as http://127.0.0.1:2586");
    settings.push.url = pushUrl;
  }

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the database's side

/** The watcher's statements, each within the grants of korbat_notify: its four tables and order_rules(), nothing else. */
export interface NotifyStore {
  /** A folder's mark: its validity and the highest UID inserted, or null before the first read. */
  folderMark(folder: ContactFolder): Promise<{ uidvalidity: number | null; lastUid: number | null } | null>;
  /** One message's row and the folder's mark, in one transaction; a message already there is left as it is. */
  insertMessage(folder: ContactFolder, uidvalidity: number, uid: number, receivedAt: Date): Promise<void>;
  /** The folder's mark as the round leaves it, also when the folder held nothing new. */
  setMark(folder: ContactFolder, uidvalidity: number, lastUid: number): Promise<void>;
  /**
   * Every row still owed its push: not pushed, of a kind with a push leg, younger than push_owed_minutes. Priority 5
   * first; within a priority an order's rows and each subject's first ring (step 0) first; then oldest first (3f's
   * review, operations3: a flood of escalations never holds an order's reminder behind it).
   */
  owedPushes(kinds: readonly AlertKind[]): Promise<OwedPush[]>;
  markPushed(id: number): Promise<void>;
  /** One more failed attempt, for the log: no cap. */
  markFailed(id: number): Promise<void>;
  /**
   * The beat: now, and now for the mailbox and the push when the round read both folders and pushed what it owed, or
   * pushed until ntfy's request limit asked it to wait (the channel's check reads a fresh push_ok_at as ntfy answering).
   */
  beat(state: { mailboxOk: boolean; pushOk: boolean; error: NotifyError | null }): Promise<void>;
}

/** A list of words as a PostgreSQL array, for `= any(...)`. The kinds are the contracts' own words: no comma or quote. */
const textArray = (values: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${values.join(",")}}`}::text[]`;

export function createStore(db: Db): NotifyStore {
  return {
    async folderMark(folder) {
      const [row] = await db.execute<{ uidvalidity: string | null; last_uid: string | null }>(sql`select uidvalidity, last_uid from public.notify_folders where folder = ${folder}`);
      return row ? { uidvalidity: row.uidvalidity === null ? null : Number(row.uidvalidity), lastUid: row.last_uid === null ? null : Number(row.last_uid) } : null;
    },
    async insertMessage(folder, uidvalidity, uid, receivedAt) {
      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        // The unique key of folder, validity and UID drops a message read twice (a round stopped before its mark).
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at) values (${folder}, ${uidvalidity}, ${uid}, ${receivedAt.toISOString()}) on conflict do nothing`);
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.notify_folders (folder, uidvalidity, last_uid) values (${folder}, ${uidvalidity}, ${uid})
          on conflict (folder) do update set uidvalidity = excluded.uidvalidity,
            last_uid = greatest(case when public.notify_folders.uidvalidity = excluded.uidvalidity then public.notify_folders.last_uid else 0 end, excluded.last_uid)`);
      });
    },
    async setMark(folder, uidvalidity, lastUid) {
      await db.execute(sql`insert into public.notify_folders (folder, uidvalidity, last_uid) values (${folder}, ${uidvalidity}, ${lastUid})
        on conflict (folder) do update set uidvalidity = excluded.uidvalidity, last_uid = excluded.last_uid`);
    },
    async owedPushes(kinds) {
      const rows = await db.execute<{ id: string; kind: AlertKind; priority: number; scope: AlertScope; facts: Record<string, number | string> }>(sql`
        select o.id, o.kind, o.priority, o.scope, o.facts from public.alert_outbox o
         where o.pushed_at is null and o.kind = any(${textArray(kinds)})
           and o.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => (select r.push_owed_minutes from public.order_rules() r))
         order by o.priority desc, (o.order_id is not null) desc, coalesce(o.step = 0, false) desc, o.id`);
      return rows.map((row) => ({ id: Number(row.id), kind: row.kind, priority: row.priority === 5 ? 5 : 3, scope: row.scope, facts: row.facts }));
    },
    async markPushed(id) {
      await db.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where id = ${id} and pushed_at is null`);
    },
    async markFailed(id) {
      await db.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set push_attempts = push_attempts + 1 where id = ${id}`);
    },
    async beat({ mailboxOk, pushOk, error }) {
      await db.execute(sql`insert into public.notify_state (id, beat_at, mailbox_ok_at, push_ok_at, error)
        values (1, now(), case when ${mailboxOk} then now() end, case when ${pushOk} then now() end, ${error})
        on conflict (id) do update set beat_at = excluded.beat_at,
          mailbox_ok_at = coalesce(excluded.mailbox_ok_at, public.notify_state.mailbox_ok_at),
          push_ok_at = coalesce(excluded.push_ok_at, public.notify_state.push_ok_at),
          error = excluded.error`);
    },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the round

export interface WatcherDeps {
  store: NotifyStore;
  imap: NotifySettings["imap"];
  push: NotifySettings["push"];
  fetch: typeof fetch;
  now(): Date;
  log: Logger;
}

export interface RoundReport {
  /** Both folders were read. */
  mailboxOk: boolean;
  /** Every publish of the round succeeded, or nothing was owed, or it stopped at ntfy's request limit with none failed. */
  pushOk: boolean;
  /** The word of the round's last failure, or null. */
  error: NotifyError | null;
  /** ntfy's request limit answered 429 and the round published nothing more: the rest wait for the next round. */
  throttled: boolean;
  inserted: number;
  pushed: number;
}

/**
 * The watcher's loop body, holding its IMAP connection from one round to the next. A failure of the mail host or of
 * ntfy is a word in the beat; a failure of the database is thrown, for the caller to judge.
 */
export function createWatcher(deps: WatcherDeps) {
  let session: ImapSession | null = null;

  /** Both folders, INBOX and then the junk folder, from each one's mark; answers how many messages it inserted. */
  async function readMailbox(): Promise<number> {
    // NOOP keeps the connection between rounds; a dropped one is found here and opened again in this round.
    if (session !== null && !session.closed) {
      try {
        await session.noop();
      } catch (err) {
        if (!(err instanceof ImapFailure)) throw err;
        session.close();
        session = null;
      }
    }
    if (session === null || session.closed) session = await openImap(deps.imap);
    let inserted = 0;
    const folders: [ContactFolder, string][] = [
      ["inbox", "INBOX"],
      ["junk", deps.imap.junk],
    ];
    for (const [folder, name] of folders) {
      const validity = await session.examine(name);
      const mark = await deps.store.folderMark(folder);
      // A changed (or first) validity resets the mark: the folder is read whole, and its messages are new rows.
      const last = mark !== null && mark.uidvalidity === validity ? (mark.lastUid ?? 0) : 0;
      const messages = await session.fetchSince(last);
      for (const message of messages) {
        await deps.store.insertMessage(folder, validity, message.uid, message.internalDate);
        inserted++;
      }
      await deps.store.setMark(folder, validity, messages.at(-1)?.uid ?? last);
    }
    return inserted;
  }

  async function round(): Promise<RoundReport> {
    let error: NotifyError | null = null;
    let mailboxOk = false;
    let inserted = 0;
    try {
      inserted = await readMailbox();
      mailboxOk = true;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ImapFailure)) throw err;
      error = err.word;
      deps.log.warn({ error: err.word, reason: err.message }, "notify: the mailbox could not be read this round");
      session?.close();
      session = null;
    }
    let pushOk = true;
    let pushed = 0;
    let throttled = false;
    for (const row of await deps.store.owedPushes(PUSH_KINDS)) {
      const outcome = await publish(deps.fetch, deps.push.url, deps.push.token, row, deps.now());
      if (outcome === "ok") {
        await deps.store.markPushed(row.id);
        pushed++;
      } else if (outcome === "throttled") {
        // 3f's review (operations3): ntfy is up and asks the publisher to wait. The row stays owed with no attempt
        // counted, the beat does not say the push failed, and the round stops here: every later row would be refused
        // too, and one taken after a refill mid-round would go ahead of the rows in front of it.
        throttled = true;
        deps.log.warn({ alert: row.id, kind: row.kind, pushed }, "notify: ntfy's request limit was reached; the rest are published from the next round");
        break;
      } else {
        await deps.store.markFailed(row.id);
        pushOk = false;
        error = outcome;
        deps.log.warn({ error: outcome, alert: row.id, kind: row.kind }, "notify: a push was not taken; it is tried again next round");
      }
    }
    await deps.store.beat({ mailboxOk, pushOk, error });
    return { mailboxOk, pushOk, error, throttled, inserted, pushed };
  }

  /** LOGOUT and the connection closed. */
  async function stop(): Promise<void> {
    const open = session;
    session = null;
    await open?.logout();
  }

  return { round, stop };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the process

/** Runs the loop until SIGTERM. Never returns. */
export async function runNotify(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): Promise<void> {
  const settings = readSettings(env);
  const log = pino({ level: env.LOG_LEVEL?.trim() || "info", base: { service: "notify" } });
  const db = createDb(settings.databaseUrl, { max: 2 });
  const watcher = createWatcher({ store: createStore(db), imap: settings.imap, push: settings.push, fetch, now: () => new Date(), log });
  const pollMs = ALERT_RULES.pollSeconds * 1000;
  let lastRoundEnd = Date.now();
  /** When the database first failed a round, or null while it answers. */
  let databaseDownSince: number | null = null;
  let stopping = false;

  // A round that hangs (a socket that never answers, a statement that never returns) is ended by Docker: the watchdog
  // exits, and the container is started again.
  const watchdog = setInterval(() => {
    if (Date.now() - lastRoundEnd > WATCHDOG_MS) {
      log.error("notify: no round has finished for two minutes; exiting so that Docker starts it again");
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }, 10_000);
  watchdog.unref();

  process.once("SIGTERM", () => {
    stopping = true;
    void (async () => {
      await watcher.stop().catch(() => undefined);
      await closeDb(db).catch(() => undefined);
      process.exit(0);
    })();
  });

  log.info({ host: settings.imap.host, port: settings.imap.port }, "notify: started");
  while (!stopping) {
    try {
      const report = await watcher.round();
      databaseDownSince = null;
      writeFileSync(HEALTH_FILE, String(Date.now()));
      if (report.inserted > 0 || report.pushed > 0 || report.error !== null || report.throttled) log.info(report, "notify: round");
    } catch (err) {
      databaseDownSince ??= Date.now();
      log.error({ err }, "notify: a round could not reach the database");
      if (Date.now() - databaseDownSince > pollMs) {
        log.error("notify: the database has been unreachable for longer than a round; exiting so that Docker starts it again");
        process.exit(1);
      }
    }
    lastRoundEnd = Date.now();
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, pollMs));
  }
}

const invokedDirectly = process.argv[1] !== undefined && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;
if (invokedDirectly) {
  runNotify().catch((err: unknown) => {
    // A setting it cannot start without: one sentence that names it, and exit 1.
    console.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    process.exit(1);
  });
}
```

```ts
import { renderAlert, type AlertFacts, type AlertKind, type AlertScope, type NotifyError } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**
 * The watcher's publisher (3f design, sections 5 and 7.1 step 5): one row of alert_outbox as one publish to ntfy, at
 * http://ntfy:2586/<topic> in the stack, with the publisher's token. The push is the title and the one sentence of the
 * row's kind in the contracts' ALERT_TEXTS, filled from the row's facts, which hold counts and UTC times only, so a lock
 * screen shows that an alert of a kind went out at a time and nothing else. The kind is the push's tag.
 */

/** The ntfy topic of each scope: the phone on call subscribes to the first, every staff phone to the second. */
export const TOPICS: Record<AlertScope, string> = { on_call: "korbat-oncall", all: "korbat-all" };

/** How long one publish may take before it counts as a failure to connect. */
const PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** A row still owed its push, as the watcher reads it. */
export interface OwedPush {
  id: number;
  kind: AlertKind;
  priority: 3 | 5;
  scope: AlertScope;
  facts: AlertFacts;
}

/**
 * "throttled" (3f's review, operations3): ntfy answered 429, its visitor request limit. ntfy is up and took the token; the
 * row waits for its turn, and the round's beat does not count it as a failure.
 */
export type PublishOutcome = "ok" | "throttled" | Extract<NotifyError, "push_connect" | "push_refused">;

/**
 * Publishes one row: a 200 is "ok", a 429 "throttled", any other answer push_refused, and a request that fails or does
 * not finish in time push_connect. Never throws.
 */
export async function publish(fetchFn: typeof fetch, baseUrl: string, token: string, row: OwedPush, now: Date): Promise<PublishOutcome> {
  let text: { title: string; sentence: string };
  try {
    text = renderAlert(row.kind, row.facts, now);
  } catch {
    // A row whose facts do not fill its words is never published with a hole in it.
    return "push_refused";
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetchFn(`${baseUrl}/${TOPICS[row.scope]}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        "x-priority": String(row.priority),
        "x-tags": row.kind,
        "x-title": text.title,
        "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
      },
      body: text.sentence,
      redirect: "error",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
    // The answer's body is ntfy's message as JSON; nothing in it is needed.
    await res.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
    return res.status === 200 ? "ok" : res.status === 429 ? "throttled" : "push_refused";
  } catch {
    return "push_connect";
  }
}
```

```ts
import { and, desc, eq, gte, isNotNull, lt, lte, sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE, type AuditExportLine, type AuditExportedParams, type AuditMarkRequest, type AuditPage, type AuditPageQuery, type StaffStoredAssertion } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { auditLog, copyMarks, profiles, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { boundLockWaits } from "../lib/lock-bounds";

/** What a read runs through: the pool, or a transaction that should see its own writes. */
type Querier = Pick<Db, "select">;

/**
 * One staff action's row on the record, as the staff module writes it for actions on public tables (3c's decisions are
 * the first). The auth side's rows (sign-ins, revocations, role changes) are not written here: the auth module writes them
 * through auth.append_audit in the transaction of their change. The trigger sets the id, the time, the place and the
 * hashes, whatever an insert supplies, so none is taken here.
 */
export interface StaffAuditRow {
  /** The staff account that acted; 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 for the server itself. */
  actorId: string;
  action: string;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  requestId: string | null;
  /** What the action was, never an email, IP, device or phone: the reader never shows it, but the record keeps it for good. */
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** The handle of the staff session the action came from. */
  staffSession?: string | null;
  /** A step-up's key, action hash and assertion go together, as the table's check requires. */
  keyId?: string | null;
  actionHash?: string | null;
  stepUp?: StaffStoredAssertion | null;
}

/** A row's place in the chain and its hash. */
export interface AuditPlace {
  seq: number;
  hash: string;
}

/**
 * Writes a staff action's row in the caller's transaction, which also holds the action's change, so the fact is in the
 * record exactly when its change commits. The insert takes the chain's head and holds it until that transaction ends, so
 * it must be the transaction's last statement: nothing that can wait (another row lock, Valkey, a mail) may run between
 * it and the commit, or every other audit write waits too.
 */
export async function appendAuditRow(tx: DbTx, row: StaffAuditRow): Promise<AuditPlace> {
  const [written] = await tx
    .insert(auditLog)
    .values({
      actorId: row.actorId,
      action: row.action,
      targetType: row.targetType,
      targetId: row.targetId,
      requestId: row.requestId,
      metadata: row.metadata ?? {},
      staffSession: row.staffSession ?? null,
      keyId: row.keyId ?? null,
      actionHash: row.actionHash ?? null,
      stepUp: row.stepUp ?? null,
    })
    .returning({ seq: auditLog.chainSeq, hash: auditLog.hash });
  return written!;
}

/**
 * The place of the newest copy mark of this account (3f Task 6, sections 7.16 and 8.7): where its next download of the
 * audit log's tail starts; null before its first. The system actor's marks are staff.js audit-export's own.
 */
export async function lastCopiedPlace(q: Querier, staffId: string): Promise<number | null> {
  const [row] = await q.select({ place: copyMarks.place }).from(copyMarks).where(eq(copyMarks.staffId, staffId)).orderBy(desc(copyMarks.at), desc(copyMarks.id)).limit(1);
  return row?.place ?? null;
}

/**
 * One page of the record, newest first by place (3a design, section 7): from the newest row, from before `cursor`, or the
 * page whose newest row is at place `at` (the keeper's "Go to place"), optionally only one action (the home screen's
 * sign-ins) or (3f Task 6, "What one key confirmed") only the rows a step-up of one key confirmed in a period. Each entry
 * names its actor by the actor's public handle, null for the server or an account without one, and the key a step-up
 * confirmed it with by its id; it never carries the metadata. With the reader's own account (3f Task 6) the page carries
 * the place of that account's newest copy mark. Reading is not itself recorded.
 */
export async function auditPage(q: Querier, query: AuditPageQuery, staffId: string | null = null): Promise<AuditPage> {
  const conditions: SQL[] = [];
  if (query.cursor !== undefined) conditions.push(lt(auditLog.chainSeq, query.cursor));
  if (query.at !== undefined) conditions.push(lte(auditLog.chainSeq, query.at));
  if (query.action !== undefined) conditions.push(eq(auditLog.action, query.action));
  if (query.key !== undefined) {
    // A step-up leaves its key, its hash and its assertion together (audit_log_step_up_complete): a row with the key and
    // no hash is a key's own row (its enrolment, its revocation), which no key confirmed.
    conditions.push(eq(auditLog.keyId, query.key), isNotNull(auditLog.actionHash));
    if (query.from !== undefined) conditions.push(gte(auditLog.createdAt, new Date(query.from)));
    if (query.to !== undefined) conditions.push(lte(auditLog.createdAt, new Date(query.to)));
  }
  // One row more than a page, to know whether another page follows.
  const rows = await q
    .select({
      seq: auditLog.chainSeq,
      hash: auditLog.hash,
      createdAt: auditLog.createdAt,
      actorHandle: profiles.handle,
      action: auditLog.action,
      targetType: auditLog.targetType,
      targetId: auditLog.targetId,
      actionHash: auditLog.actionHash,
      stepKeyId: auditLog.keyId,
    })
    .from(auditLog)
    // A profile's id is its account's id; the system actor and an account that never chose a handle have none.
    .leftJoin(profiles, eq(profiles.id, auditLog.actorId))
    .where(and(...conditions))
    .orderBy(desc(auditLog.chainSeq))
    .limit(STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE + 1);
  const entries = rows.slice(0, STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE).map(({ stepKeyId, ...row }) => ({
    ...row,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    // The key a step-up confirmed the row with; a key's own rows (keyId without a hash) are about the key, not by it.
    keyId: row.actionHash === null ? null : stepKeyId,
  }));
  return {
    entries,
    nextCursor: rows.length > STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE ? entries[entries.length - 1]!.seq : null,
    copy: { lastPlace: staffId === null ? null : await lastCopiedPlace(q, staffId) },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the daily copy (3f design, sections 6.6 and 7.16)

/** How many rows one read of the download takes at a time. */
export const EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;

/** What a page of the export reads through: the pool or the command line's connection. */
type Reader = Pick<Db, "execute">;

/** A row of the chain as the download writes it: the canonical text's members as stored, and the two hashes. */
interface LineRow {
  id: string | number;
  chain_version: number;
  chain_seq: string | number;
  created_at: string;
  actor_id: string;
  action: string;
  target_type: string | null;
  target_id: string | null;
  request_id: string | null;
  staff_session: string | null;
  key_id: string | null;
  action_hash: string | null;
  step_up: string | null;
  metadata: string;
  prev_hash: string;
  hash: string;
}

/**
 * The rows after place `after` up to place `through`, oldest first, as lines of the download (AuditExportLine): read in
 * pages by place and id, each page a statement of its own (the log is append-only, so the pages read the one record). The
 * jsonb columns come as PostgreSQL prints them (a `::text` cast), which the canonical text embeds as it is, so a keeper's
 * file recomputes every hash with staff/chain.ts and nothing of the database's; the time is the row's millisecond, in UTC.
 */
export async function* exportLines(q: Reader, after: number, through: number): AsyncGenerator<AuditExportLine> {
  let from: { seq: number; id: number } | null = null;
  for (;;) {
    const page = (await q.execute(sql`
      select l.id, l.chain_version, l.chain_seq, to_char(l.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as created_at,
             l.actor_id, l.action, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.request_id, l.staff_session, l.key_id, l.action_hash,
             l.step_up::text as step_up, l.metadata::text as metadata, l.prev_hash, l.hash
        from public.audit_log l
       where l.chain_seq > ${after}::bigint and l.chain_seq <= ${through}::bigint
         ${from === null ? sql`` : sql`and (l.chain_seq, l.id) > (${from.seq}::bigint, ${from.id}::bigint)`}
       order by l.chain_seq, l.id
       limit ${EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE}`)) as unknown as LineRow[];
    for (const row of page) {
      yield {
        v: row.chain_version,
        place: Number(row.chain_seq),
        id: Number(row.id),
        at: row.created_at,
        actor: row.actor_id,
        action: row.action,
        targetType: row.target_type,
        targetId: row.target_id,
        requestId: row.request_id,
        staffSession: row.staff_session,
        keyId: row.key_id,
        actionHash: row.action_hash,
        stepUp: row.step_up,
        metadata: row.metadata,
        prevHash: row.prev_hash,
        hash: row.hash,
      };
    }
    if (page.length < EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE) return;
    const last = page[page.length - 1]!;
    from = { seq: Number(last.chain_seq), id: Number(last.id) };
  }
}

/** The newest place of the chain (0 for an empty log), read from the head the trigger moves. */
async function headPlace(q: Reader): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`select h.seq::text as seq from public.audit_head h where h.id = 1`)) as unknown as { seq: string }[];
  return Number(row?.seq ?? 0);
}

/** The message of an exception the database raised as its code (SQLSTATE P0001); null for anything else. */
function raised(err: unknown): string | null {
  let current: unknown = err;
  for (let depth = 0; depth < 5 && current; depth++) {
    const c = current as { code?: unknown; message?: unknown; cause?: unknown };
    if (typeof c.code === "string") return c.code === "P0001" && typeof c.message === "string" ? c.message : null;
    current = c.cause;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * A download that was released: its places and how many rows; or why none was: the confirming account or key ended, the
 * challenge's time ran out, or the download would end after the newest place.
 */
export type ExportOutcome = { after: number; through: number; rows: number; copyTaken: boolean } | "ended" | "late" | "beyond_head";

/** The locks the download's transaction may wait for: the acting account's row, the key and the audit head. */
const EXPORT_WAITS = 3;

/**
 * POST /api/staff/audit/export, once its step-up verified (sections 6.6 and 7.16 steps 2 and 3): the download is a
 * confirmed action, since a line carries its row's metadata, which the audit page never shows. One transaction holds
 * append_confirmed_audit alone, the action audit_exported on the target `audit` with the params it releases: a key's
 * confirmation is used once, so the action that used it has its row, which says who took which places also when the file
 * never arrives. It writes no mark: the mark is the keeper's confirmation (markCopy). `through` may not be after the head,
 * since the file would end short. Answers the places and whether every staff account is to be alerted (copy_taken): when
 * anyone but the caller holds the newest copy mark, or nobody does. 3f's review (access5): as built only staff members'
 * marks were read, and no mark was an alert to nobody, so a stolen key's download went unseen while the keeper copied
 * only with staff.js audit-export, which marks as the system, or on a fresh installation.
 */
export async function exportAudit(db: Db, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<ExportOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never releases the record: a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "audit_exported" || confirmed.target.type !== "audit" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) throw new Error("the audit download needs the step-up that confirmed it");
  const params = confirmed.params as AuditExportedParams;
  if (String(params.through) !== confirmed.target.id) throw new Error("the audit download's target is the place it ends at");
  if (params.through > (await headPlace(db))) return "beyond_head";
  // The newest copy, the command line's included, is read before the transaction: the alert is told after the commit
  // and decides nothing.
  const [holder] = (await db.execute(sql`select m.staff_id from public.copy_marks m order by m.at desc, m.id desc limit 1`)) as unknown as { staff_id: string }[];
  try {
    const outcome = await db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<"done" | "late"> => {
      if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, EXPORT_WAITS))) return "late";
      await tx.execute(
        sql`select public.append_confirmed_audit(${session.userId}::uuid, ${confirmed.keyId}::uuid, 'audit_exported'::text, 'audit'::text, ${confirmed.target.id}::text,
              ${JSON.stringify({ params: confirmed.params })}::text::jsonb, ${session.handle}::uuid, ${confirmed.actionHash}::text, ${JSON.stringify(confirmed.assertion)}::text::jsonb,
              ${ctx.requestId}::text, ${confirmed.expiresAt.getTime()}::bigint)`,
      );
      return "done";
    });
    if (outcome === "late") return "late";
  } catch (err) {
    const refusal = raised(err);
    if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
    if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
    throw err;
  }
  return { after: params.after, through: params.through, rows: params.through - params.after, copyTaken: holder === undefined || holder.staff_id !== session.userId };
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark (sections 6.6 and 7.16 step 4): the keeper's confirmation that the console holds the
 * whole file, which it has checked runs without a break. One transaction: the row at the place `through` holds that hash,
 * and the caller's own newest audit_exported row signed that `through` (copy_mismatch, 409, otherwise, also for a place
 * the caller did not download with a key); then the caller's copy mark and the plain audit row copy_marked, with the
 * places the mark covers. No key: it shows nothing, and it can only say "I hold it" of a file a key released. Answers
 * "mismatch", with nothing written, when either test fails.
 */
export async function markCopy(db: Db, session: ActiveStaffSession, request: AuditMarkRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<"marked" | "mismatch"> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    const [at] = (await tx.execute(sql`select l.hash from public.audit_log l where l.chain_seq = ${request.through}::bigint`)) as unknown as { hash: string }[];
    const [released] = (await tx.execute(
      sql`select (l.metadata -> 'params' ->> 'after')::bigint::text as after, (l.metadata -> 'params' ->> 'through')::bigint::text as through
            from public.audit_log l where l.action = 'audit_exported' and l.actor_id = ${session.userId}::uuid
           order by l.chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    )) as unknown as { after: string; through: string }[];
    if (at === undefined || at.hash !== request.hash || released === undefined || Number(released.through) !== request.through) return "mismatch";
    const after = Number(released.after);
    // The API role inserts these two columns alone; the trigger forces the mark's time.
    await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${session.userId}::uuid, ${request.through}::bigint)`);
    await appendAuditRow(tx, {
      actorId: session.userId,
      action: "copy_marked",
      targetType: null,
      targetId: null,
      requestId: ctx.requestId,
      staffSession: session.handle,
      metadata: { after, through: request.through, rows: request.through - after },
    });
    return "marked" as const;
  });
}
```
